Löyly spec v2 — event model

Löyly rebuilds a software product from its written specification in a clean room, lets a gate it does not control decide whether the rebuild works, and scores the result item by item, one cycle at a time.

domain eventunhappy pathhandoff, in time order
Time runs left to right: scroll sideways.

Every domain event, in the order a cycle happens, one band per part of the system. Under each sticky, who or what triggers it; arrows hand work from one part to the next. Click a band or a sticky to open it.

Drill down

Each context's event model (commands, events, the views they feed), then its spec cards (each rule in plain words with its Given/When/Then), then under the hood (the Allium, the Grain blocks, the flows and handoffs).

06-cycle-runner · Cycle runner

Cycle runner: the ORC workflow that performs one cycle's effects (stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install and gate with repair, file the verdicts and the score) and records each effect's result into the context that owns it, relaying every handoff from its producer's store. About this page

Level 0 · the big picture · built from .pi/spec at 44970d2

The Pi harness, specified as 6 bounded contexts. Each is a slice of its own: its Allium, its Grain Event Model, its stamped scenarios. The contexts meet only through handoffs, events one context defines and others read; the cycle runner relays each from its producer's store.

6 contexts27 domain events201 stamped items26 drafts8 handoffsbuilt 2026-11-11

Each context is specified in three layers

behaviourAllium.pi/spec/<context>/allium/*.allium: one file per aggregate and the context's shared language. Its state and lifecycle, the rules that change it (when · requires · ensures), invariants, contracts, and the surfaces that say who may act.
topologyEvent Model.pi/spec/<context>/event-model/*.edn: Grain Event Model fragments (commands, events with schemas, read models, queries, policies, screens) and the flows that join them. Each block links back to its Allium rule.
examplesGherkin.pi/spec/<context>/spec.feature and drafts.feature: Given/When/Then, each accepted scenario stamped @item-NN-SSS with its build tier, and tagged @allium-… with the obligations it checks. A rule's success and each of its refusals is one obligation.

What the product owner reviews

The coverage gate's own result (tools/spec/v2/coverage.py): every must-cover Allium obligation of a context should be tagged @allium-<obligation> on an accepted scenario of its spec.feature, or on a draft in its drafts.feature. Only the product owner moves a draft into spec.feature.

Drafts awaiting acceptance

Scenarios proposed for obligations no accepted scenario covers; each opens the rule where it is shown in full. The harness does not read them until they are accepted and stamped.

  • A slice that was stamped before keeps one numbering .pi/spec/specification/drafts.feature:14
  • Another slice's spec file is refused .pi/spec/specification/drafts.feature:25
  • An item identity handed over twice is known once .pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:13
  • The measurement receipt shows every verdict and reason, the denominator, the unreached count and the superseded verdicts .pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:24
  • The score stage hands the checklist and the gated candidate to a child grading workflow .pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:43
  • An item the open grader leaves out is filed as fail with the reason unreached .pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:55
  • An open grader that returns no verdicts files no score .pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:65
  • The open grader's surprise is on the measurement receipt and the verdict stands .pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:76
  • The open grader decides for each step whether it needs a model .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:22
  • The open grader reaches the candidate only through the seam tools .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:33
  • A step that names anything but a seam tool or the grader's own contained code is refused and recorded .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:43
  • The open grader hands an item to an explore session and still files the verdict itself .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:53
  • The operator finds a grading run by slice, cycle and candidate .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:66
  • A trial grading run is kept in no history and files nothing .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:76
  • A grading run that stayed on the seam is audited clean .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:87
  • An explore session that reached past the seam is named as a breach .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/drafts.feature:96
  • The clean room keeps the spec and the application contract and loses every prior candidate and grader .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:13
  • A passing harness self-check before a gate attempt opens no cycle .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:25
  • A regenerate stage that outlives its timeout fails the cycle with reason budget .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:36
  • Gate refusals that spend no attempt are still bounded by the gate stage's timeout .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:45
  • The stage clock does not fail a cycle waiting at the scoreboard .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:56
  • Passing a cycle that never opened is refused .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:68
  • Failing a cycle that never opened is refused .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:77
  • No harness policy starts a stage .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:86
  • A score stage failed before the gate passed is not the cycle's .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/drafts.feature:97
  • Two source cuts of one commit carry the same tree digest .pi/spec/cycle-preparation/drafts.feature:13

Open questions

Allium open questions, listed on each Allium file's page.

  • Measurement · Context: H16: can an outage leave a false 'scored' record? Zero verdicts are refused, but a partial outage still files, with the unreached items failed; an 'outage' reason is now recordable (H7) but nothing yet requires it.
  • Measurement · Context: H21: should the scoreboard also report graded coverage, so a low rate is not read as the candidate's quality alone?
  • Measurement · Context: H7: which runtime evidence makes a verdict 'inconclusive' or 'outage'? R2 records the reason as the grader returns it.
  • Grader lifecycle · Context: H19: who checks that a recorded reason is true? Only spec_grew has an enforceable test (additions only); instrument_behavior_changed and wording_replaced are a person's word.
  • Grader lifecycle · Context: H27: the legacy files still say 'oracle' for three different things (oracle.sh, oracle/, kalibra's oracle.py); when are they renamed to glossary terms?
  • Regeneration cycle · Context: H24 (part): does the self-check key also cover the capture policy? It waits for runtime evidence (R2 question 4).
  • Cycle preparation · Context: H35: does an unapproved preparation, or an unused cut, expire?
  • Cycle preparation · Context: H5: the budget (gate-attempt limit, outer cycles, a timeout per stage, continuations) belongs to the approved preparation. Until it is modelled, ORC gives it to the cycle with its first self-check (regeneration-cycle); confirm that the preparation, when it arrives, carries exactly those fields.

Architecture

How the architecture grows from the event storm: its bands are the bounded contexts; the events one context hands to another are how they link; then the containers that run them and the components inside. The harness as it runs, at three levels of zoom.

6 bounded contexts8 handoffs8 C4 viewssource .pi/architecture.md

Bounded contexts, and how they link

Each event a context hands out (its event-model/handoffs.edn), and each context whose read models or policies read it. This is the assembly the cycle runner's relay drives: 8 handoffs, 9 producer-consumer edges.

Level 1 · event model · bounded context · slice 01-specification

Specification

Specification: the Gherkin scenarios and the item identity stamped on each. Upstream of every cycle; owns the published language (item identity, stamped scenario).

1 flows1 commands2 events1 read models2 rules15 stamped items2 drafts

How it flows

Each flow of the event model, left to right: who triggers it, the command, the event it records, and the read model or view that shows it next. Click a sticky for its spec card.

who triggers itcommandeventread model / view

Stamping

A scenario is stamped once; its item identity is what a checklist may count. The flow stays inside this context: what Measurement does with a stamped scenario is its own flow (measurement/stamping-to-checklist), so this context's model validates on its own, as a candidate registers it.

Handoffs

The events this context hands to others (its event-model/handoffs.edn) and those it reads from others, each defined once by its producer. The cycle runner relays each from the producer's store to the consumer.

A scenario is stamped once; its item identity is what a checklist may count. The flow stays inside this context: what Measurement does with a stamped scenario is its own flow (measurement/stamping-to-checklist), so this context's model validates on its own, as a candidate registers it.

Context

Scope: the shared language of Specification, the open host. Every other context conforms to its published language: the item identity, the stamped scenario, and how a Gherkin file is read into scenarios and items (contract ScenarioReading). Aggregates (one file each; .pi/spec/specification/event-model/): Slice slice.allium one per slice's spec file: its stamped items and the next free number, from a ledger that never goes down Handoff produced: ScenarioStamped, to measurement (slice.allium). Legacy: stamp_item_ids.clj and the reading gen_checklist.clj shares with it (archive/legacy-harness/spec.feature, @harness-001 to @harness-022, @harness-049).

Item tag from the contiguous tag run

1 example

A scenario's item tag is the last "@item-<slice>-<number>" tag in the contiguous run of tag lines (lines that start with "@" after stripping) directly above its heading. A blank line, a comment or any other text ends the run, and a tag separated from its scenario that way does not stamp it (legacy @harness-005, @harness-019). The checklist's legacy "pending tag" that survived any line until a heading consumed it (@harness-020) is not kept: it was a second reading.

Level 2 · spec cards · slice.allium in Specification

Slice

Aggregate Slice, in the project repository: one per slice's spec file (event-model/slice.edn). The consistency boundary for "an item identity is handed out once and never renumbered or reused": the next number of a slice is one past the highest it ever handed out, from a ledger that never goes down (decisions.md; legacy @harness-004 counted from the file, so deleting the highest scenario lowered it, @harness-010). Stamping is idempotent: a scenario already stamped produces nothing, so a rerun records nothing (legacy @harness-007, @harness-008). An empty-title heading is not an item; the stamper reports it loudly, every time it runs (decisions.md, R2 question 6).

Source: .pi/spec/specification/allium/slice.allium · .pi/spec/specification/event-model/slice.edn
rule StampFirstScenarios {
    when: StampSlice(author, slice_number, source, unstamped, empty_title_lines)
    -- 1. no spec found: the refusal names where it looked, and is not "fully stamped"
    --    (legacy @harness-011; decisions.md "to add" 2)
    requires: spec_exists(source)
    -- 2. the source is not this slice's spec file
    requires: slice_of(source) = slice_number
    -- 3. the slice already has a ledger (StampSlice applies)
    requires: not exists Slice{number: slice_number}
    -- 4. the scenarios offered are not exactly the file's unstamped ones, in file order
    requires: unstamped = unstamped_scenarios(source)
    -- 5. the empty-title headings reported are not exactly the file's: none is hidden
    --    (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6)
    requires: empty_title_lines = empty_title_lines_of(source)
    ensures:
        if empty_title_lines.count > 0:
            EmptyTitleHeadingsReported(slice: slice_number, source: source, lines: empty_title_lines)
        let slice = Slice.created(number: slice_number, next_number: 1 + unstamped.count)
        for s in unstamped:
            StampedItem.created(slice: slice, item_id: item_identity(slice_number, 1 + index_of(unstamped, s)), number: 1 + index_of(unstamped, s), source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title, stamped_at: now)
            ScenarioStamped(item_id: item_identity(slice_number, 1 + index_of(unstamped, s)), slice: slice_number, source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title)
}

Source: .pi/spec/specification/allium/slice.allium · .pi/spec/specification/event-model/slice.edn
rule StampSlice {
    when: StampSlice(author, slice_number, source, unstamped, empty_title_lines)
    let slice = Slice{number: slice_number}
    -- 1. no spec found (legacy @harness-011; "to add" 2)
    requires: spec_exists(source)
    -- 2. the source is not this slice's spec file
    requires: slice_of(source) = slice_number
    -- 3. the slice has no ledger yet (StampFirstScenarios applies)
    requires: exists slice
    -- 4. the scenarios offered are not exactly the file's unstamped ones, in file order: a
    --    scenario already stamped is never stamped again
    requires: unstamped = unstamped_scenarios(source)
    -- 5. the empty-title headings reported are not exactly the file's: none is hidden
    --    (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6)
    requires: empty_title_lines = empty_title_lines_of(source)
    let first = slice.next_number
    ensures:
        if empty_title_lines.count > 0:
            EmptyTitleHeadingsReported(slice: slice_number, source: source, lines: empty_title_lines)
        slice.next_number = first + unstamped.count
        for s in unstamped:
            StampedItem.created(slice: slice, item_id: item_identity(slice_number, first + index_of(unstamped, s)), number: first + index_of(unstamped, s), source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title, stamped_at: now)
            ScenarioStamped(item_id: item_identity(slice_number, first + index_of(unstamped, s)), slice: slice_number, source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title)
}

What always holds, what a surface promises, and what a contract holds at the boundary, each with the scenarios that check it.

invariant

One ledger per slice

no example yet · 1 draft

Invariants

A slice that was stamped before keeps one numberingdraft

Under the hoodAllium invariant OneLedgerPerSlice · @allium-invariant.OneLedgerPerSlice
invariant OneLedgerPerSlice {
    for a in Slices:
        for b in Slices:
            a != b implies a.number != b.number
}
invariant

Identity handed out once

1 example

An identity is handed out once (legacy @harness-008 to @harness-010).

Stamping twice changes nothing

Then no scenario is stamped
And the stamper reports slice 03 fully stamped
And each item identity of slice 03 still names exactly one stamped item

    for a in StampedItems:
        for b in StampedItems:
            a != b implies a.item_id != b.item_id
}
invariant

Numbers below the ledger

1 example

Every number handed out lies below the ledger's next number, so it is never handed out again, even after its scenario is deleted.

A deleted scenario's number is never handed out again

And the scenario stamped "@item-03-004" was deleted from "plan/03-gate/spec.feature"

And the next item identity slice 03 hands out is "@item-03-006"

source.pi/spec/specification/spec.feature:35 minimum
Under the hoodAllium invariant NumbersBelowTheLedger · @allium-invariant.NumbersBelowTheLedger
invariant NumbersBelowTheLedger {
    for i in StampedItems:
        i.number >= 1 and i.number < i.slice.next_number
}
guarantee

Never derived from wording

1 example

An item identity is carried in the spec file and never computed from the scenario's text; rewording a scenario keeps its identity (legacy @harness-009), so cycles stay comparable item by item.

rule StampFirstScenarios {
    when: StampSlice(author, slice_number, source, unstamped, empty_title_lines)
    -- 1. no spec found: the refusal names where it looked, and is not "fully stamped"
    --    (legacy @harness-011; decisions.md "to add" 2)
    requires: spec_exists(source)
    -- 2. the source is not this slice's spec file
    requires: slice_of(source) = slice_number
    -- 3. the slice already has a ledger (StampSlice applies)
    requires: not exists Slice{number: slice_number}
    -- 4. the scenarios offered are not exactly the file's unstamped ones, in file order
    requires: unstamped = unstamped_scenarios(source)
    -- 5. the empty-title headings reported are not exactly the file's: none is hidden
    --    (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6)
    requires: empty_title_lines = empty_title_lines_of(source)
    ensures:
        if empty_title_lines.count > 0:
            EmptyTitleHeadingsReported(slice: slice_number, source: source, lines: empty_title_lines)
        let slice = Slice.created(number: slice_number, next_number: 1 + unstamped.count)
        for s in unstamped:
            StampedItem.created(slice: slice, item_id: item_identity(slice_number, 1 + index_of(unstamped, s)), number: 1 + index_of(unstamped, s), source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title, stamped_at: now)
            ScenarioStamped(item_id: item_identity(slice_number, 1 + index_of(unstamped, s)), slice: slice_number, source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title)
}
stamp-sliceCommand · :specification

Stamp every unstamped scenario of one slice's spec file with the slice's next item identity, in file order. Idempotent: a scenario already stamped produces nothing; no identity is renumbered or reused, and none is derived from wording. An empty-title heading is not an item: the stamper reports each one loudly, by line (decisions.md, R2 question 6). Issued by: operator (spec author), through the stamper.

Source: .pi/spec/specification/allium/slice.allium · .pi/spec/specification/event-model/slice.edn
rule StampSlice {
    when: StampSlice(author, slice_number, source, unstamped, empty_title_lines)
    let slice = Slice{number: slice_number}
    -- 1. no spec found (legacy @harness-011; "to add" 2)
    requires: spec_exists(source)
    -- 2. the source is not this slice's spec file
    requires: slice_of(source) = slice_number
    -- 3. the slice has no ledger yet (StampFirstScenarios applies)
    requires: exists slice
    -- 4. the scenarios offered are not exactly the file's unstamped ones, in file order: a
    --    scenario already stamped is never stamped again
    requires: unstamped = unstamped_scenarios(source)
    -- 5. the empty-title headings reported are not exactly the file's: none is hidden
    --    (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6)
    requires: empty_title_lines = empty_title_lines_of(source)
    let first = slice.next_number
    ensures:
        if empty_title_lines.count > 0:
            EmptyTitleHeadingsReported(slice: slice_number, source: source, lines: empty_title_lines)
        slice.next_number = first + unstamped.count
        for s in unstamped:
            StampedItem.created(slice: slice, item_id: item_identity(slice_number, first + index_of(unstamped, s)), number: first + index_of(unstamped, s), source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title, stamped_at: now)
            ScenarioStamped(item_id: item_identity(slice_number, first + index_of(unstamped, s)), slice: slice_number, source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title)
}

rule StampSlice {
    when: StampSlice(author, slice_number, source, unstamped, empty_title_lines)
    let slice = Slice{number: slice_number}
    -- 1. no spec found (legacy @harness-011; "to add" 2)
    requires: spec_exists(source)
    -- 2. the source is not this slice's spec file
    requires: slice_of(source) = slice_number
    -- 3. the slice has no ledger yet (StampFirstScenarios applies)
    requires: exists slice
    -- 4. the scenarios offered are not exactly the file's unstamped ones, in file order: a
    --    scenario already stamped is never stamped again
    requires: unstamped = unstamped_scenarios(source)
    -- 5. the empty-title headings reported are not exactly the file's: none is hidden
    --    (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6)
    requires: empty_title_lines = empty_title_lines_of(source)
    let first = slice.next_number
    ensures:
        if empty_title_lines.count > 0:
            EmptyTitleHeadingsReported(slice: slice_number, source: source, lines: empty_title_lines)
        slice.next_number = first + unstamped.count
        for s in unstamped:
            StampedItem.created(slice: slice, item_id: item_identity(slice_number, first + index_of(unstamped, s)), number: first + index_of(unstamped, s), source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title, stamped_at: now)
            ScenarioStamped(item_id: item_identity(slice_number, first + index_of(unstamped, s)), slice: slice_number, source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title)
}

Source: .pi/spec/specification/allium/slice.allium · .pi/spec/specification/event-model/slice.edn
rule StampFirstScenarios {
    when: StampSlice(author, slice_number, source, unstamped, empty_title_lines)
    -- 1. no spec found: the refusal names where it looked, and is not "fully stamped"
    --    (legacy @harness-011; decisions.md "to add" 2)
    requires: spec_exists(source)
    -- 2. the source is not this slice's spec file
    requires: slice_of(source) = slice_number
    -- 3. the slice already has a ledger (StampSlice applies)
    requires: not exists Slice{number: slice_number}
    -- 4. the scenarios offered are not exactly the file's unstamped ones, in file order
    requires: unstamped = unstamped_scenarios(source)
    -- 5. the empty-title headings reported are not exactly the file's: none is hidden
    --    (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6)
    requires: empty_title_lines = empty_title_lines_of(source)
    ensures:
        if empty_title_lines.count > 0:
            EmptyTitleHeadingsReported(slice: slice_number, source: source, lines: empty_title_lines)
        let slice = Slice.created(number: slice_number, next_number: 1 + unstamped.count)
        for s in unstamped:
            StampedItem.created(slice: slice, item_id: item_identity(slice_number, 1 + index_of(unstamped, s)), number: 1 + index_of(unstamped, s), source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title, stamped_at: now)
            ScenarioStamped(item_id: item_identity(slice_number, 1 + index_of(unstamped, s)), slice: slice_number, source: source, line: s.line, title: s.title)
}

Level 1 · event model · bounded context · slice 02-measurement

Measurement

Measurement (instrument: score and scoreboard): the checklist that sets the denominator, one filed measurement per cycle with unreached items failed and counted, and the scoreboard to a person.

3 flows5 commands6 events8 read models9 rules43 stamped items6 drafts

How it flows

Each flow of the event model, left to right: who triggers it, the command, the event it records, and the read model or view that shows it next. Click a sticky for its spec card.

who triggers itcommandeventread model / view

Scoring

A cycle the gate ratified (handoff from the Regeneration cycle) opens its measurement; the approved sealed grader files its item verdicts for the gated candidate, and ORC runtime files the one measurement, or records the score stage failed when the score was refused. The Regeneration cycle's own flow shows the same steps from its side; this one keeps them inside Measurement, so its model validates alone with the handoffs it consumes and each command of it runs as an ORC workflow of its own context (decisions.md, "Slice 02").

  • Note item identity The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

Scope: the shared language of Measurement (the instrument: checklist, score and scoreboard).

Cycle measurement4 rules · 19 scenariosOpen →

Aggregate CycleMeasurement, in the harness's event store: one per gated cycle (event-model/cycle-measurement.edn).

  • Open measurement The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only
  • File item verdicts The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only
  • File score The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
  • Fail score stage A refused score fails the score stage, once, and the score is never retaken within the cycle
Scoreboard2 rules · 8 scenariosOpen →

Aggregate Scoreboard, in the harness's event store: one per measured cycle (event-model/scoreboard.edn).

  • Report scoreboard once The scoreboard is reported once a cycle, to a person, never into the loop
  • Report scoreboard The scoreboard is reported once a cycle, to a person, never into the loop

Scenarios on no single rule

Scenarios of .pi/spec/measurement/spec.feature tagged with no rule, invariant or guarantee (a journey), by their Gherkin Rule:.

journey

The score stage delegates grading to a child grading workflow over the gated candidate

The score stage hands the checklist and the gated candidate to a child grading workflowdraft
Given the checklist of source cut K-3 holds 03-001, 03-002 and 03-003
And gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 at K-3 passed for candidate D-1
When ORC runtime runs the score stage of C-7
Then a child grading workflow grades the checklist of K-3, each item with its scenario, against D-1 only
And the item verdicts it returns are filed for D-1 of C-7, with the grading run they came from
draft, not stamped
source.pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:43 draft
journey

The open grader returns one verdict per item with evidence; an item it leaves out is unreached

An item the open grader leaves out is filed as fail with the reason unreacheddraft
Given the checklist of source cut K-3 holds 03-001, 03-002 and 03-003
And gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 at K-3 passed for candidate D-1
When the open grader returns pass for 03-001 and fail for 03-002, each with its evidence, and nothing for 03-003
Then the measurement of C-7 files 03-001 as pass and 03-002 as fail, each with its evidence
And files 03-003 as fail with the reason unreached, and its total is 3
draft, not stamped
source.pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:55 draft
An open grader that returns no verdicts files no scoredraft
Given gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 passed for candidate D-1
When the child grading workflow of C-7 ends with no item verdicts, finished or not
Then no score of C-7 is filed
And the score stage of C-7 fails as zero verdicts
draft, not stamped
source.pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:65 draft
journey

A surprise is recorded beside the measurement and never changes a verdict

The open grader's surprise is on the measurement receipt and the verdict standsdraft
Given gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 passed for candidate D-1
When the open grader returns pass for 03-001 with the surprise "the scenario and seam.md disagree on the refusal's wording"
Then the measurement of C-7 files 03-001 as pass
And the measurement receipt of C-7 shows the surprise beside 03-001, apart from the item verdicts
draft, not stamped
source.pi/spec/measurement/drafts.feature:76 draft

Open questions

Allium open questions: what no source settles yet.

  • H16: can an outage leave a false 'scored' record? Zero verdicts are refused, but a partial outage still files, with the unreached items failed; an 'outage' reason is now recordable (H7) but nothing yet requires it.
  • H21: should the scoreboard also report graded coverage, so a low rate is not read as the candidate's quality alone?
  • H7: which runtime evidence makes a verdict 'inconclusive' or 'outage'? R2 records the reason as the grader returns it.

The boundary: what holds everywhere

The actors that may act (Operator, SpecificationContext, CyclePreparationContext, Grader, OrcRuntime, RegenerationCycleContext, Operator, Operator), any contract every surface fulfils, and what others own.

outside the harnessOperatorAccountGraderRunOperatorAccount
EveryChecklistItemInChecklistOrder · The measurement holds every checklist item once, in the checklist's order; the order of the verdicts is discarded (legacy @harness-029).1 scenariocontract Scoring · @allium-boundary.EveryChecklistItemInChecklistOrder
@minimum@allium-rule-success.FileScore@allium-invariant.CountedWithinTheDenominator@allium-invariant.FiledFromAtLeastOneFiling@allium-boundary.EveryChecklistItemInChecklistOrder@item-02-012minimum
Scenario: The measurement holds every checklist item once, in checklist order
Given the checklist of source cut K-3 holds 03-001, 03-002 and 04-001, in that order
And gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 at K-3 passed for candidate D-1
And the grader with approved digest G-1 filed fail for 04-001, pass for 03-001 and pass for 03-002 for D-1
When ORC runtime files the score of C-7 with the approved grader digests G-1
Then the measurement of C-7 is filed with 03-001, 03-002 and 04-001 in that order
And its total is 3, its passes 2 and its unreached 0
And it carries the checklist digest of K-3 and the grader digest G-1

Level 2 · spec cards · checklist.allium in Measurement

Checklist

Aggregate Checklist, in the harness's event store: one per pinned cut in the core, one per approved selection once selection arrives (event-model/checklist.edn). Derived, never written; it sets the denominator. Legacy: gen_checklist.clj. Two storm events are refusals here, not events: "Unstamped scenario found" (refusal 2, which lists every unstamped scenario of every file; decisions.md) and "Empty selection refused" (refusal 3). The checklist reads the spec with Specification's published reading of Gherkin (specification/allium/context.allium, contract ScenarioReading), the same one the stamper uses.

3 rules10 scenarios2 drafts15 obligations covered · 2 drafted · 0 uncovered

Rules

One card per rule: what it says in plain words, then the scenarios that show it. Drafts, not yet accepted, have a dashed amber edge. The Allium, the Grain block and the coverage of each card are under its hood.

rule

Derive checklist

7 examples · 1 happy path

The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

Derive the checklist of a pinned cut: one stamped item per stamped scenario of every slice not planned or backlog, in file order; the slices skipped by status are recorded. Issued by the operator. Refusals 1-6 from R1; 7 added in R2 ("to add" 1).

Given
  • Issued by Operator
When
Derive checklist
Refused if
  • The cut is not pinned ✓ 02-033
  • A scenario is unstamped: every one, in every file, is listed, and the refusal names the stamper (legacy @harness-023) ✓ 02-004
  • The checklist would be empty, whether no spec, every slice skipped, or no scenario at all (legacy @harness-025, @harness-026; the hole of @harness-022 closed) ✓ 02-005
  • An item identity the stamper never handed out: the spec is the only author ✓ 02-006
  • An item identity twice ✓ 02-034
  • A checklist already derived for the cut ◇ unit test
  • An item with an empty title: a Scenario line with nothing after the colon is no scenario; a title of only whitespace is one (legacy @harness-021, @harness-049) ✓ 02-007
  • ✓ checked by an example · ◇ checked only by the code's own tests
Then
  • createsChecklist
  • emitsChecklist derived

And its checklist digest is the digest of those three stamped items

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/checklist.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/checklist.edn
rule DeriveChecklist {
    when: DeriveChecklist(operator, cut_id, selection_id, items, unstamped, skipped_slices)
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. a scenario is unstamped: every one, in every file, is listed, and the refusal
    --    names the stamper (legacy @harness-023; decisions.md: every unstamped file listed)
    requires: unstamped.count = 0
    -- 3. the checklist would be empty, whether no spec, every slice skipped, or no
    --    scenario at all (legacy @harness-025, @harness-026; the hole of @harness-022 closed)
    requires: items.count > 0
    -- 4. an item identity the stamper never handed out: the spec is the only author
    requires: items.all(i => exists ItemIdentity{item_id: i.item_id})
    -- 5. an item identity twice
    requires: ids_of(items).count = items.count
    -- 6. a checklist already derived for the cut
    requires: not exists Checklist{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 7. an item with an empty title: a Scenario line with nothing after the colon is no
    --    scenario; a title of only whitespace is one (legacy @harness-021, @harness-049)
    requires: items.all(i => i.title != "")
    ensures:
        Checklist.created(
            cut_id: cut_id,
            selection_id: selection_id,
            checklist_digest: digest_of(items),
            items: items,
            item_ids: ids_of(items),
            total: items.count,
            skipped_slices: skipped_slices,
            derived_at: now
        )
        ChecklistDerived(cut_id: cut_id, selection_id: selection_id, checklist_digest: digest_of(items), items: items, total: items.count, skipped_slices: skipped_slices)
}

Level 2 · spec cards · context.allium in Measurement

Context

Scope: the shared language of Measurement (the instrument: checklist, score and scoreboard). Every other file of the context uses this one. The instrument reports to a person, once a cycle, and never into the loop (AGENTS.md, The instrument). Nothing here issues a command of the build loop; its three handoffs only conclude the cycle. Aggregates (one file each; .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/): Checklist checklist.allium one per pinned cut; the denominator CycleMeasurement cycle-measurement.allium one per gated cycle: the filed verdicts, the one measurement, or the failed stage Scoreboard scoreboard.allium one per measured cycle; the report-scoreboard-once policy Handoffs consumed: specification ScenarioStamped and cycle-preparation SourceCutPinned (checklist.allium); regeneration-cycle GateAttemptPassed (cycle-measurement.allium). Produced: MeasurementFiled, ScoreStageFailed (cycle-measurement.allium) and ScoreboardReported (scoreboard.allium), to the regeneration cycle, only to conclude. Legacy: gen_checklist.clj, score.clj, scoreboard.clj (archive/legacy-harness), in the glossary's words (.pi/model/GLOSSARY.md).

Open questions

  • H16: can an outage leave a false 'scored' record? Zero verdicts are refused, but a partial outage still files, with the unreached items failed; an 'outage' reason is now recordable (H7) but nothing yet requires it.

Level 2 · spec cards · cycle-measurement.allium in Measurement

Cycle measurement

Aggregate CycleMeasurement, in the harness's event store: one per gated cycle (event-model/cycle-measurement.edn). The approved sealed grader files the verdicts it returned; the instrument files the one measurement, with every checklist item: an unreached item fails and stays counted. A false record cannot be untaken, so a doubtful one is refused. Legacy: score.clj. The storm's "Score refused" is the refusals of FileItemVerdicts and FileScore. ORC's score node then records the failed stage (FailScoreStage), a fact and a handoff: the conclude policy fails the cycle and the score is never retaken within it.

File item verdicts

11 examples · 1 happy path

The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only

A refused score fails the score stage, once, and the score is never retaken within the cycle

File the verdicts one approved sealed grader returned for the gated candidate of a cycle, having driven it only over its public seam. Issued by the grader (its run reported by ORC runtime). Refusals in the order the score checks them: a bad verdict value before an unknown item.

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FileItemVerdicts {
    when: FileItemVerdicts(grader, cycle_id, candidate_digest, grader_digest, approved_grader_digests, verdicts)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle's gate ratified no candidate (not_the_gated_candidate)
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. another candidate than the one the gate ratified (not_the_gated_candidate; H13)
    requires: candidate_digest = measurement.candidate_digest
    -- 3. no checklist for the cycle's cut (no_checklist; legacy @harness-040)
    requires: exists cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}
    -- 4. zero verdicts: the grading did not happen, not everything failed (zero_verdicts;
    --    legacy @harness-032, @harness-033)
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    -- 5. a verdict other than pass or fail (bad_verdict_value; legacy @harness-039)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.verdict = "pass" or v.verdict = "fail")
    -- 6. a verdict for an item not on the checklist: the spec is the only author of the
    --    item list (unknown_item; legacy @harness-038)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.item_id in cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}.item_ids)
    -- 7. the measurement is already filed
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 8. the score stage already failed: it is never retaken within the cycle
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    -- 9. the grader digest is not an approved one (grader_not_approved; H13)
    requires: grader_digest in approved_grader_digests
    -- 10. a reason other than inconclusive or outage, or beside a pass; unreached is the
    --     instrument's to give (bad_verdict_reason; H7)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.reason != null implies (v.verdict = "fail" and (v.reason = "inconclusive" or v.reason = "outage")))
    ensures:
        VerdictFiling.created(measurement: measurement, grader_digest: grader_digest, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, verdicts: verdicts, filed_at: now)
        ItemVerdictsFiled(cycle_id: cycle_id, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, grader_digest: grader_digest, verdicts: verdicts)
}

rule

File score

5 examples · 1 happy path

The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

File the cycle's one measurement from the verdicts filed: every checklist item, the last verdict for an item superseding the earlier ones, and an item with no verdict filed as fail with reason unreached. Issued by ORC runtime (the score node) once its grader runs are done. Refusals 1-4 from R1; 5-6 added in R2 (H13).

Given
  • Gate attempt passed (Cycle measurement status is awaiting score)
  • Issued by ORC runtime
When
File score
Refused if
  • The cycle is not gated ✓ 02-038
  • Zero verdicts filed ✓ 02-017
  • Already filed: a false record cannot be untaken ✓ 02-029
  • The score stage failed ◇ unit test
  • A grader digest no longer approved, re-checked when the score is filed (H13) ✓ 02-030
  • A filing for another candidate than the gated one (H13); guarded by: FileItemVerdicts.2 (a filing for another candidate is refused when it is filed) ◇ unit test
  • ✓ checked by an example · ◇ checked only by the code's own tests
Then
  • updatesCycle measurement filed at → now
  • updatesCycle measurement status → filed
  • updatesCycle measurement unreached
  • updatesCycle measurement passes
  • updatesCycle measurement checklist digest
  • updatesCycle measurement selection id
  • updatesCycle measurement grader digests
  • updatesCycle measurement items → items
  • updatesCycle measurement total
  • updatesCycle measurement superseded
  • emitsMeasurement filed → Regeneration cycle
Examples
The measurement holds every checklist item once, in checklist orderhappy path
Given the checklist of source cut K-3 holds 03-001, 03-002 and 04-001, in that order
And gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 at K-3 passed for candidate D-1
And the grader with approved digest G-1 filed fail for 04-001, pass for 03-001 and pass for 03-002 for D-1
When ORC runtime files the score of C-7 with the approved grader digests G-1
Then the measurement of C-7 is filed with 03-001, 03-002 and 04-001 in that order
And its total is 3, its passes 2 and its unreached 0
And it carries the checklist digest of K-3 and the grader digest G-1
covers 4 obligations
  • success File score
  • invariant Counted within the denominator
  • invariant Filed from at least one filing
  • boundary Every checklist item in checklist order

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FileScore {
    when: FileScore(orc, cycle_id, approved_grader_digests)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle is not gated
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. zero verdicts filed
    requires: measurement.filings.count > 0
    -- 3. already filed: a false record cannot be untaken
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 4. the score stage failed
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    -- 5. a grader digest no longer approved, re-checked when the score is filed (H13)
    requires: measurement.filings.all(f => f.grader_digest in approved_grader_digests)
    -- 6. a filing for another candidate than the gated one (H13); guarded by:
    --    FileItemVerdicts.2 (a filing for another candidate is refused when it is filed)
    requires: measurement.filings.all(f => f.candidate_digest = measurement.candidate_digest)
    let checklist = cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}
    let items = scored_items(checklist, measurement.filings)
    ensures:
        measurement.status = filed
        measurement.selection_id = checklist.selection_id
        measurement.checklist_digest = checklist.checklist_digest
        measurement.grader_digests = grader_digests_of(measurement.filings)
        measurement.total = checklist.total
        measurement.passes = passes_of(items)
        measurement.unreached = unreached_of(items)
        measurement.items = items
        measurement.superseded = superseded(measurement.filings)
        measurement.filed_at = now
        MeasurementFiled(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: measurement.cut_id, selection_id: checklist.selection_id, candidate_digest: measurement.candidate_digest, checklist_digest: checklist.checklist_digest, grader_digests: grader_digests_of(measurement.filings), total: checklist.total, passes: passes_of(items), unreached: unreached_of(items), items: items, superseded: superseded(measurement.filings))
}

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FailScoreStage {
    when: FailScoreStage(orc, cycle_id, refusal, detail)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle is not gated
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. the measurement is filed
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 3. already failed
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    ensures:
        measurement.status = score_stage_failed
        measurement.refusal = refusal
        ScoreStageFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

Allium source.pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium
entity CycleMeasurement {
    cycle_id: String
    cut_id: String
    -- The candidate the gate ratified: the score binds it (decisions.md H13).
    candidate_digest: String
    status: awaiting_score | filed | score_stage_failed
    filings: VerdictFiling with measurement = this
    selection_id: String when status = filed
    checklist_digest: String when status = filed
    grader_digests: Set<String> when status = filed
    total: Integer when status = filed
    passes: Integer when status = filed
    unreached: Integer when status = filed
    items: List<Any> when status = filed
    superseded: List<Any> when status = filed
    filed_at: Timestamp when status = filed
    refusal: ctx.ScoreRefusal when status = score_stage_failed

    transitions status {
        awaiting_score -> filed
        awaiting_score -> score_stage_failed
        terminal: filed, score_stage_failed
    }
}
entity VerdictFiling {
    measurement: CycleMeasurement
    grader_digest: String
    candidate_digest: String
    verdicts: List<ctx.ReturnedVerdict>
    filed_at: Timestamp
}

Level 2 · spec cards · scoreboard.allium in Measurement

Scoreboard

Aggregate Scoreboard, in the harness's event store: one per measured cycle (event-model/scoreboard.edn). It reports to a person: the rate, and against the last measured cycle of the same selection only the shared items, newly passing and newly failing apart, new items as the untuned holdout, never a net. Legacy: scoreboard.clj.

2 rules8 scenarios0 drafts12 obligations covered · 0 drafted · 0 uncovered

One card per rule: what it says in plain words, then the scenarios that show it. Drafts, not yet accepted, have a dashed amber edge. The Allium, the Grain block and the coverage of each card are under its hood.

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/scoreboard.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/scoreboard.edn
rule ReportScoreboard {
    when: ReportScoreboard(cycle_id)
    let measurement = cm/CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. no measurement filed for the cycle (legacy @harness-043: nothing recorded)
    requires: exists measurement and measurement.status = filed
    -- 2. already reported
    requires: not exists Scoreboard{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    let previous = last_measured_before(measurement)
    ensures:
        Scoreboard.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            selection_id: measurement.selection_id,
            passes: measurement.passes,
            total: measurement.total,
            rate: rate(measurement.passes, measurement.total),
            previous_cycle_id: previous?.cycle_id,
            previous_selection_id: previous?.selection_id,
            reported_at: now
        )
        ScoreboardReported(cycle_id: cycle_id, selection_id: measurement.selection_id, passes: measurement.passes, total: measurement.total, rate: rate(measurement.passes, measurement.total), previous_cycle_id: previous?.cycle_id, previous_selection_id: previous?.selection_id, shared: shared_items(measurement, previous), new_items: new_items(measurement, previous), dropped_items: dropped_items(measurement, previous))
        if previous != null and item_set_moved(measurement, previous):
            MovedItemSetRestated(cycle_id: cycle_id, previous_cycle_id: previous.cycle_id, previous_total: previous.total, total: measurement.total, added: new_items(measurement, previous).count, dropped: dropped_items(measurement, previous).count)
}

What always holds, what a surface promises, and what a contract holds at the boundary, each with the scenarios that check it.

invariant

One scoreboard per cycle

1 example

Invariants

A cycle's scoreboard is reported once

source.pi/spec/measurement/spec.feature:456 balance
Under the hoodAllium invariant OneScoreboardPerCycle · @allium-invariant.OneScoreboardPerCycle
invariant OneScoreboardPerCycle {
    for a in Scoreboards:
        for b in Scoreboards:
            a != b implies a.cycle_id != b.cycle_id
}
invariant

Never compared with itself

1 example

A cycle is never its own baseline.

A cycle after an unscored one is compared with the last measured cycle, not the one before it
Given cycle C-5 of the whole-plan selection was measured
And cycle C-6 of the whole-plan selection failed at the gate and has no measurement
When the measurement of cycle C-7 of the whole-plan selection is filed
Then the scoreboard of C-7 is compared with C-5
And never with C-6 or with C-7 itself
covers 3 obligations

  • invariant Never compared with itself

guarantee

Both directions never anet

1 example

Against the previous measured cycle the shared items are compared, newly passing and newly failing apart; no net is computed (legacy @harness-045).

Promised by surface ScoreboardReport

Newly passing and newly failing shared items are counted apart, with no net
Given cycle C-6 of the whole-plan selection was measured with 03-001 pass and 03-002 fail
When the measurement of cycle C-7 of the whole-plan selection is filed with 03-001 fail and 03-002 pass
Then the scoreboard of C-7 lists 03-002 as newly passing and 03-001 as newly failing
And it shows the shared items' rates for C-6 and C-7
And it computes no net

  • boundary Both directions on the shared items never anet

Then the scoreboard of C-7 counts 04-001 as a new item, the untuned holdout

Then the scoreboard of C-7 restates the comparison on the shared items, with previous total 3, total 4, 1 added and 0 dropped

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FailScoreStage {
    when: FailScoreStage(orc, cycle_id, refusal, detail)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle is not gated
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. the measurement is filed
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 3. already failed
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    ensures:
        measurement.status = score_stage_failed
        measurement.refusal = refusal
        ScoreStageFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

rule ReportScoreboard {
    when: ReportScoreboard(cycle_id)
    let measurement = cm/CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. no measurement filed for the cycle (legacy @harness-043: nothing recorded)
    requires: exists measurement and measurement.status = filed
    -- 2. already reported
    requires: not exists Scoreboard{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    let previous = last_measured_before(measurement)
    ensures:
        Scoreboard.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            selection_id: measurement.selection_id,
            passes: measurement.passes,
            total: measurement.total,
            rate: rate(measurement.passes, measurement.total),
            previous_cycle_id: previous?.cycle_id,
            previous_selection_id: previous?.selection_id,
            reported_at: now
        )
        ScoreboardReported(cycle_id: cycle_id, selection_id: measurement.selection_id, passes: measurement.passes, total: measurement.total, rate: rate(measurement.passes, measurement.total), previous_cycle_id: previous?.cycle_id, previous_selection_id: previous?.selection_id, shared: shared_items(measurement, previous), new_items: new_items(measurement, previous), dropped_items: dropped_items(measurement, previous))
        if previous != null and item_set_moved(measurement, previous):
            MovedItemSetRestated(cycle_id: cycle_id, previous_cycle_id: previous.cycle_id, previous_total: previous.total, total: measurement.total, added: new_items(measurement, previous).count, dropped: dropped_items(measurement, previous).count)
}

Given gate attempt 1 of cycle C-7 passed for candidate D-1
And the grader's item verdicts for C-7 were refused as an unknown item
When ORC runtime records the score stage of C-7 failed for the refusal unknown item
Then the score stage of C-7 is failed, naming the refusal unknown item
And the measurement receipt of C-7 shows the refusal and no score

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FailScoreStage {
    when: FailScoreStage(orc, cycle_id, refusal, detail)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle is not gated
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. the measurement is filed
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 3. already failed
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    ensures:
        measurement.status = score_stage_failed
        measurement.refusal = refusal
        ScoreStageFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

Scenario: The checklist holds one stamped item per stamped scenario of the source cut
Given source cut K-3 was pinned
And the stamper handed out item identities 03-001, 03-002 and 04-001
And slices 03 and 04 hold exactly those three stamped scenarios at K-3
When the operator derives the checklist of K-3
Then the checklist of K-3 is derived with the stamped items 03-001, 03-002 and 04-001
And its total is 3
And its checklist digest is the digest of those three stamped items
.pi/spec/measurement/spec.feature:12 · Rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/checklist.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/checklist.edn
rule DeriveChecklist {
    when: DeriveChecklist(operator, cut_id, selection_id, items, unstamped, skipped_slices)
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. a scenario is unstamped: every one, in every file, is listed, and the refusal
    --    names the stamper (legacy @harness-023; decisions.md: every unstamped file listed)
    requires: unstamped.count = 0
    -- 3. the checklist would be empty, whether no spec, every slice skipped, or no
    --    scenario at all (legacy @harness-025, @harness-026; the hole of @harness-022 closed)
    requires: items.count > 0
    -- 4. an item identity the stamper never handed out: the spec is the only author
    requires: items.all(i => exists ItemIdentity{item_id: i.item_id})
    -- 5. an item identity twice
    requires: ids_of(items).count = items.count
    -- 6. a checklist already derived for the cut
    requires: not exists Checklist{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 7. an item with an empty title: a Scenario line with nothing after the colon is no
    --    scenario; a title of only whitespace is one (legacy @harness-021, @harness-049)
    requires: items.all(i => i.title != "")
    ensures:
        Checklist.created(
            cut_id: cut_id,
            selection_id: selection_id,
            checklist_digest: digest_of(items),
            items: items,
            item_ids: ids_of(items),
            total: items.count,
            skipped_slices: skipped_slices,
            derived_at: now
        )
        ChecklistDerived(cut_id: cut_id, selection_id: selection_id, checklist_digest: digest_of(items), items: items, total: items.count, skipped_slices: skipped_slices)
}

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FileItemVerdicts {
    when: FileItemVerdicts(grader, cycle_id, candidate_digest, grader_digest, approved_grader_digests, verdicts)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle's gate ratified no candidate (not_the_gated_candidate)
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. another candidate than the one the gate ratified (not_the_gated_candidate; H13)
    requires: candidate_digest = measurement.candidate_digest
    -- 3. no checklist for the cycle's cut (no_checklist; legacy @harness-040)
    requires: exists cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}
    -- 4. zero verdicts: the grading did not happen, not everything failed (zero_verdicts;
    --    legacy @harness-032, @harness-033)
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    -- 5. a verdict other than pass or fail (bad_verdict_value; legacy @harness-039)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.verdict = "pass" or v.verdict = "fail")
    -- 6. a verdict for an item not on the checklist: the spec is the only author of the
    --    item list (unknown_item; legacy @harness-038)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.item_id in cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}.item_ids)
    -- 7. the measurement is already filed
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 8. the score stage already failed: it is never retaken within the cycle
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    -- 9. the grader digest is not an approved one (grader_not_approved; H13)
    requires: grader_digest in approved_grader_digests
    -- 10. a reason other than inconclusive or outage, or beside a pass; unreached is the
    --     instrument's to give (bad_verdict_reason; H7)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.reason != null implies (v.verdict = "fail" and (v.reason = "inconclusive" or v.reason = "outage")))
    ensures:
        VerdictFiling.created(measurement: measurement, grader_digest: grader_digest, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, verdicts: verdicts, filed_at: now)
        ItemVerdictsFiled(cycle_id: cycle_id, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, grader_digest: grader_digest, verdicts: verdicts)
}

Given no cycle of the whole-plan selection was measured before cycle C-7

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/scoreboard.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/scoreboard.edn
rule ReportScoreboard {
    when: ReportScoreboard(cycle_id)
    let measurement = cm/CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. no measurement filed for the cycle (legacy @harness-043: nothing recorded)
    requires: exists measurement and measurement.status = filed
    -- 2. already reported
    requires: not exists Scoreboard{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    let previous = last_measured_before(measurement)
    ensures:
        Scoreboard.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            selection_id: measurement.selection_id,
            passes: measurement.passes,
            total: measurement.total,
            rate: rate(measurement.passes, measurement.total),
            previous_cycle_id: previous?.cycle_id,
            previous_selection_id: previous?.selection_id,
            reported_at: now
        )
        ScoreboardReported(cycle_id: cycle_id, selection_id: measurement.selection_id, passes: measurement.passes, total: measurement.total, rate: rate(measurement.passes, measurement.total), previous_cycle_id: previous?.cycle_id, previous_selection_id: previous?.selection_id, shared: shared_items(measurement, previous), new_items: new_items(measurement, previous), dropped_items: dropped_items(measurement, previous))
        if previous != null and item_set_moved(measurement, previous):
            MovedItemSetRestated(cycle_id: cycle_id, previous_cycle_id: previous.cycle_id, previous_total: previous.total, total: measurement.total, added: new_items(measurement, previous).count, dropped: dropped_items(measurement, previous).count)
}

rule DeriveChecklist {
    when: DeriveChecklist(operator, cut_id, selection_id, items, unstamped, skipped_slices)
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. a scenario is unstamped: every one, in every file, is listed, and the refusal
    --    names the stamper (legacy @harness-023; decisions.md: every unstamped file listed)
    requires: unstamped.count = 0
    -- 3. the checklist would be empty, whether no spec, every slice skipped, or no
    --    scenario at all (legacy @harness-025, @harness-026; the hole of @harness-022 closed)
    requires: items.count > 0
    -- 4. an item identity the stamper never handed out: the spec is the only author
    requires: items.all(i => exists ItemIdentity{item_id: i.item_id})
    -- 5. an item identity twice
    requires: ids_of(items).count = items.count
    -- 6. a checklist already derived for the cut
    requires: not exists Checklist{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 7. an item with an empty title: a Scenario line with nothing after the colon is no
    --    scenario; a title of only whitespace is one (legacy @harness-021, @harness-049)
    requires: items.all(i => i.title != "")
    ensures:
        Checklist.created(
            cut_id: cut_id,
            selection_id: selection_id,
            checklist_digest: digest_of(items),
            items: items,
            item_ids: ids_of(items),
            total: items.count,
            skipped_slices: skipped_slices,
            derived_at: now
        )
        ChecklistDerived(cut_id: cut_id, selection_id: selection_id, checklist_digest: digest_of(items), items: items, total: items.count, skipped_slices: skipped_slices)
}

rule FileItemVerdicts {
    when: FileItemVerdicts(grader, cycle_id, candidate_digest, grader_digest, approved_grader_digests, verdicts)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle's gate ratified no candidate (not_the_gated_candidate)
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. another candidate than the one the gate ratified (not_the_gated_candidate; H13)
    requires: candidate_digest = measurement.candidate_digest
    -- 3. no checklist for the cycle's cut (no_checklist; legacy @harness-040)
    requires: exists cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}
    -- 4. zero verdicts: the grading did not happen, not everything failed (zero_verdicts;
    --    legacy @harness-032, @harness-033)
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    -- 5. a verdict other than pass or fail (bad_verdict_value; legacy @harness-039)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.verdict = "pass" or v.verdict = "fail")
    -- 6. a verdict for an item not on the checklist: the spec is the only author of the
    --    item list (unknown_item; legacy @harness-038)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.item_id in cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}.item_ids)
    -- 7. the measurement is already filed
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 8. the score stage already failed: it is never retaken within the cycle
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    -- 9. the grader digest is not an approved one (grader_not_approved; H13)
    requires: grader_digest in approved_grader_digests
    -- 10. a reason other than inconclusive or outage, or beside a pass; unreached is the
    --     instrument's to give (bad_verdict_reason; H7)
    requires: verdicts.all(v => v.reason != null implies (v.verdict = "fail" and (v.reason = "inconclusive" or v.reason = "outage")))
    ensures:
        VerdictFiling.created(measurement: measurement, grader_digest: grader_digest, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, verdicts: verdicts, filed_at: now)
        ItemVerdictsFiled(cycle_id: cycle_id, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, grader_digest: grader_digest, verdicts: verdicts)
}

Source: .pi/spec/measurement/allium/cycle-measurement.allium · .pi/spec/measurement/event-model/cycle-measurement.edn
rule FileScore {
    when: FileScore(orc, cycle_id, approved_grader_digests)
    let measurement = CycleMeasurement{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle is not gated
    requires: exists measurement
    -- 2. zero verdicts filed
    requires: measurement.filings.count > 0
    -- 3. already filed: a false record cannot be untaken
    requires: measurement.status in {awaiting_score, score_stage_failed}
    -- 4. the score stage failed
    requires: measurement.status = awaiting_score
    -- 5. a grader digest no longer approved, re-checked when the score is filed (H13)
    requires: measurement.filings.all(f => f.grader_digest in approved_grader_digests)
    -- 6. a filing for another candidate than the gated one (H13); guarded by:
    --    FileItemVerdicts.2 (a filing for another candidate is refused when it is filed)
    requires: measurement.filings.all(f => f.candidate_digest = measurement.candidate_digest)
    let checklist = cl/Checklist{cut_id: measurement.cut_id}
    let items = scored_items(checklist, measurement.filings)
    ensures:
        measurement.status = filed
        measurement.selection_id = checklist.selection_id
        measurement.checklist_digest = checklist.checklist_digest
        measurement.grader_digests = grader_digests_of(measurement.filings)
        measurement.total = checklist.total
        measurement.passes = passes_of(items)
        measurement.unreached = unreached_of(items)
        measurement.items = items
        measurement.superseded = superseded(measurement.filings)
        measurement.filed_at = now
        MeasurementFiled(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: measurement.cut_id, selection_id: checklist.selection_id, candidate_digest: measurement.candidate_digest, checklist_digest: checklist.checklist_digest, grader_digests: grader_digests_of(measurement.filings), total: checklist.total, passes: passes_of(items), unreached: unreached_of(items), items: items, superseded: superseded(measurement.filings))
}

}

Grader lifecycle

Grader lifecycle: the instrument's own material, on its own clock, outside every cycle. R1 holds the instrument goldens; the graders come later.

1 flows2 commands2 events1 read models2 rules11 stamped items8 drafts

How it flows

Each flow of the event model, left to right: who triggers it, the command, the event it records, and the read model or view that shows it next. Click a sticky for its spec card.

who triggers itcommandeventread model / view

Golden written then moved

A golden is written from its scenario; a move carries one of three reasons. The flow stays inside this context: the Regeneration cycle folds both golden events (handoffs) into its own read model, whose harness self-check reproduces the current goldens exactly, so this context's model validates alone, as a candidate registers it (decisions.md, "Slice 03").

journey

The open grader grades however it judges, through the candidate's public seam only

When the open grader grades 03-001 by sending one request and comparing the response with the scenario's Then
And grades 03-002 by asking a model to read a response against the scenario
Then the grading run of C-7 records a model call for 03-002 and none for 03-001
And both item verdicts are the open grader's, each with its evidence

And each start of D-1 gets an event store no earlier start used
And no seam tool reads the candidate's source

Instrument golden

Aggregate InstrumentGolden, in the harness repository: one per instrument scenario (event-model/instrument-golden.edn). The exact expected output of one instrument scenario, refusal reasons included, written from that scenario and never recorded from a run (decisions.md: goldens are written from the scenario). It carries the digest of the scenario it was written from (decisions.md h), so a reworded scenario shows. A move carries exactly one recorded reason.

Source: .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/allium/instrument-golden.allium · .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/event-model/instrument-golden.edn
rule WriteInstrumentGolden {
    when: WriteInstrumentGolden(maintainer, golden_id, scenario, scenario_digest, path, digest)
    -- 1. the golden already exists
    requires: not exists InstrumentGolden{golden_id: golden_id}
    -- 2. the scenario digest is not the digest of the scenario it is written from
    requires: scenario_digest = digest_of_scenario(scenario)
    ensures:
        InstrumentGolden.created(golden_id: golden_id, scenario: scenario, scenario_digest: scenario_digest, path: path, digest: digest, written_at: now)
        InstrumentGoldenWritten(golden_id: golden_id, scenario: scenario, scenario_digest: scenario_digest, path: path, digest: digest)
}

Move a golden to new content, with its one recorded reason. spec_grew holds only when the diff is additions only: no existing item's id, name, rule or source moved, and only the total line removed (legacy README). Issued by the instrument maintainer. Refusals 1-4 from R1; 5 added in R2.

Given
  • Issued by Instrument maintainer
When
Move instrument golden
Refused if
  • No such golden ✓ 03-010
  • The same digest: nothing moved ✓ 03-006
  • Spec_grew without an additions-only diff: the first case wearing this one's clothes ✓ 03-002
  • An empty note: the move is written down each time ✓ 03-003
  • The scenario digest is not the current digest of the golden's scenario ✓ 03-007
Then
  • createsGolden move
  • updatesGolden digest → digest
  • updatesGolden scenario digest → scenario digest
  • emitsInstrument golden moved → Regeneration cycle
Examples
The instrument maintainer moves a golden for a recorded reasonhappy path
Given instrument golden G-score-unknown was written with the digest "g-40" from a scenario with the scenario digest "s-12"
When the instrument maintainer moves G-score-unknown to the digest "g-41" for "instrument behavior changed" with the note "the refusal now names the grader digest" and the scenario digest "s-12"
Then G-score-unknown has the digest "g-41"
And its move from "g-40" to "g-41" is recorded with that reason, that note and the scenario digest "s-12"
covers 1 obligation
  • success Move instrument golden

Source: .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/allium/instrument-golden.allium · .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/event-model/instrument-golden.edn
rule MoveInstrumentGolden {
    when: MoveInstrumentGolden(maintainer, golden_id, digest, reason, additions_only, note, scenario_digest)
    let golden = InstrumentGolden{golden_id: golden_id}
    -- 1. no such golden
    requires: exists golden
    -- 2. the same digest: nothing moved
    requires: digest != golden.digest
    -- 3. spec_grew without an additions-only diff: the first case wearing this one's clothes
    requires: reason = spec_grew implies additions_only
    -- 4. an empty note: the move is written down each time
    requires: note != ""
    -- 5. the scenario digest is not the current digest of the golden's scenario
    requires: scenario_digest = digest_of_scenario(golden.scenario)
    let from_digest = golden.digest
    ensures:
        GoldenMove.created(golden: golden, from_digest: from_digest, to_digest: digest, reason: reason, additions_only: additions_only, note: note, scenario_digest: scenario_digest, moved_at: now)
        golden.digest = digest
        golden.scenario_digest = scenario_digest
        InstrumentGoldenMoved(golden_id: golden_id, from_digest: from_digest, to_digest: digest, reason: reason, additions_only: additions_only, note: note, scenario_digest: scenario_digest)
}

Invariants and guarantees

What always holds, what a surface promises, and what a contract holds at the boundary, each with the scenarios that check it.

invariant

One golden per identity

1 example

Invariants

A golden is written once
Given instrument golden G-score-unknown was written with the digest "g-40"
When the instrument maintainer writes instrument golden G-score-unknown again with the digest "g-41"
Then the writing is refused
And there is one instrument golden G-score-unknown, with the digest "g-40"
covers 1 obligation
  • invariant One golden per identity
@item-03-009
source.pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/spec.feature:96 balance
Under the hoodAllium invariant OneGoldenPerIdentity · @allium-invariant.OneGoldenPerIdentity
invariant OneGoldenPerIdentity {
    for a in InstrumentGoldens:
        for b in InstrumentGoldens:
            a != b implies a.golden_id != b.golden_id
}
invariant

Amove moves something

1 example

A move changes the content.

A move to the same digest is refused
Given instrument golden G-score-unknown has the digest "g-40"
When the instrument maintainer moves G-score-unknown to the digest "g-40" for "wording replaced" with the note "no change"
Then the move is refused
And G-score-unknown records no move
covers 2 obligations
  • refusal 2 Move instrument golden
  • invariant Amove moves something
@item-03-006
source.pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/spec.feature:65 minimum
Under the hoodAllium invariant AMoveMovesSomething · @allium-invariant.AMoveMovesSomething
invariant AMoveMovesSomething {
    for m in GoldenMoves:
        m.from_digest != m.to_digest
}
invariant

Spec grew is additions only

1 example

spec_grew is the additions-only case and no other.

"Spec grew" over a diff that is not additions only is refused
Given instrument golden G-checklist has the digest "g-50"
And its new content changes the title of an existing stamped item
When the instrument maintainer moves G-checklist to the digest "g-51" for "spec grew", with a diff that is not additions only
Then the move is refused
And G-checklist still has the digest "g-50"
covers 2 obligations
  • refusal 3 Move instrument golden
  • invariant Spec grew is additions only
@item-03-002
source.pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/spec.feature:22 minimum
Under the hoodAllium invariant SpecGrewIsAdditionsOnly · @allium-invariant.SpecGrewIsAdditionsOnly
invariant SpecGrewIsAdditionsOnly {
    for m in GoldenMoves:
        m.reason = spec_grew implies m.additions_only
}
guarantee

Written from the scenario never from arun

1 example

A golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest; it is never recorded from a run of the tools it judges.

Promised by surface InstrumentGoldenDesk

The instrument maintainer writes a golden from its scenario
Given the instrument scenario "a refused score names the unknown item" has the scenario digest "s-12"
When the instrument maintainer writes instrument golden G-score-unknown from that scenario, with the scenario digest "s-12" and the digest "g-40"
Then instrument golden G-score-unknown is written with the digest "g-40" and the scenario digest "s-12"
And the instrument goldens show G-score-unknown with the digest "g-40" and the scenario digest "s-12"
covers 2 obligations
  • success Write instrument golden
  • guarantee Written from the scenario never from arun
@item-03-008
source.pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/spec.feature:85 minimum
Under the hoodAllium guarantee WrittenFromTheScenarioNeverFromARun · @allium-guarantee.WrittenFromTheScenarioNeverFromARun

A golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest; it is never recorded from a run of the tools it judges.

guarantee

Never moved to turn it green

1 example

A golden moves only for one of the three recorded reasons; re-recording to get a green destroys the only evidence that anything moved (legacy README, What a red legacy oracle costs).

Promised by surface InstrumentGoldenDesk

A golden is never moved for a reason outside the three
Given instrument golden G-score-unknown has the digest "g-40"
When the instrument maintainer moves G-score-unknown to the digest "g-41" for "make the self-check green" with the note "it was red"
Then the move is refused, as the reason is none of "instrument behavior changed", "wording replaced" or "spec grew"
And G-score-unknown still has the digest "g-40"
covers 1 obligation
  • guarantee Never moved to turn it green
@item-03-004
source.pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/spec.feature:43 minimum

entity InstrumentGolden {
    golden_id: String
    scenario: String
    -- The digest of the scenario it was written from (decisions.md h).
    scenario_digest: String
    path: String
    digest: String
    moves: GoldenMove with golden = this
    written_at: Timestamp
}
entity GoldenMove {
    golden: InstrumentGolden
    from_digest: String
    to_digest: String
    reason: ctx.MoveReason
    additions_only: Boolean
    note: String
    scenario_digest: String
    moved_at: Timestamp
}

write-instrument-golden

Write the exact expected output, refusal reasons included, of one instrument scenario (stamping, checklist derivation, a score refusal, the scoreboard's arithmetic), from that scenario. Issued by: instrument maintainer.

Source: .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/allium/instrument-golden.allium · .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/event-model/instrument-golden.edn
rule WriteInstrumentGolden {
    when: WriteInstrumentGolden(maintainer, golden_id, scenario, scenario_digest, path, digest)
    -- 1. the golden already exists
    requires: not exists InstrumentGolden{golden_id: golden_id}
    -- 2. the scenario digest is not the digest of the scenario it is written from
    requires: scenario_digest = digest_of_scenario(scenario)
    ensures:
        InstrumentGolden.created(golden_id: golden_id, scenario: scenario, scenario_digest: scenario_digest, path: path, digest: digest, written_at: now)
        InstrumentGoldenWritten(golden_id: golden_id, scenario: scenario, scenario_digest: scenario_digest, path: path, digest: digest)
}

@item-03-001 · The instrument maintainer moves a golden for a recorded reason minimum
@minimum@allium-rule-success.MoveInstrumentGolden@item-03-001minimum
Scenario: The instrument maintainer moves a golden for a recorded reason
Given instrument golden G-score-unknown was written with the digest "g-40" from a scenario with the scenario digest "s-12"
When the instrument maintainer moves G-score-unknown to the digest "g-41" for "instrument behavior changed" with the note "the refusal now names the grader digest" and the scenario digest "s-12"
Then G-score-unknown has the digest "g-41"
And its move from "g-40" to "g-41" is recorded with that reason, that note and the scenario digest "s-12"
.pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/spec.feature:12 · Rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
Source: .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/allium/instrument-golden.allium · .pi/spec/grader-lifecycle/event-model/instrument-golden.edn
rule MoveInstrumentGolden {
    when: MoveInstrumentGolden(maintainer, golden_id, digest, reason, additions_only, note, scenario_digest)
    let golden = InstrumentGolden{golden_id: golden_id}
    -- 1. no such golden
    requires: exists golden
    -- 2. the same digest: nothing moved
    requires: digest != golden.digest
    -- 3. spec_grew without an additions-only diff: the first case wearing this one's clothes
    requires: reason = spec_grew implies additions_only
    -- 4. an empty note: the move is written down each time
    requires: note != ""
    -- 5. the scenario digest is not the current digest of the golden's scenario
    requires: scenario_digest = digest_of_scenario(golden.scenario)
    let from_digest = golden.digest
    ensures:
        GoldenMove.created(golden: golden, from_digest: from_digest, to_digest: digest, reason: reason, additions_only: additions_only, note: note, scenario_digest: scenario_digest, moved_at: now)
        golden.digest = digest
        golden.scenario_digest = scenario_digest
        InstrumentGoldenMoved(golden_id: golden_id, from_digest: from_digest, to_digest: digest, reason: reason, additions_only: additions_only, note: note, scenario_digest: scenario_digest)
}

Level 1 · event model · bounded context · slice 04-regeneration-cycle

Regeneration cycle

Regeneration cycle (harness: fence and gate): one cycle in the legacy shape, fence -> regenerate -> gate -> score -> scoreboard, and its one conclusion. The fence and the gate feed the build loop; the gated candidate goes one way to the measurement.

8 flows8 commands10 events6 read models26 rules76 stamped items9 drafts

How it flows

Each flow of the event model, left to right: who triggers it, the command, the event it records, and the read model or view that shows it next. Click a sticky for its spec card.

who triggers itcommandeventread model / view

Fence to scoreboard

The legacy cycle end to end: the harness self-checks, the fence proves the clean room, a candidate is regenerated, the gate ratifies it, the grader files item verdicts, the instrument files the measurement and reports the scoreboard, and the cycle concludes passed. The score and the scoreboard are Measurement's (its flow scoring): this flow stays inside this context and hears them as the handoffs measurement-filed and scoreboard-reported, which enter it from nil, as a command ORC runtime issues does, so its model validates alone with the handoffs it consumes (decisions.md, "Slice 04").
