Gate attempt repaired Before every gate attempt the harness self-checks again (decisions.md H24).

Before every gate attempt the harness self-checks again (decisions.md H24). A failed attempt that leaves attempts in the budget sends the cycle back to regenerate, where a repair room mounts only this cycle's gate evidence (H6), and the repaired candidate is installed in a fresh gate room. A gate refusal (seam answered before boot, identity probe missing or not the instrument's) records nothing and spends no attempt.

Spec cards

The spec, one card per rule, grouped by Allium file: the rule in plain words and its Given/When/Then. Open a file to review its cards.

Clean room1 rule · 12 scenarios · 1 draftsOpen →

Aggregate CleanRoom, in the harness's event store: one per cycle (event-model/clean-room.edn).

  • Prove clean room The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it
Context0 rules · 12 scenarios · 1 draftsOpen →

Scope: the shared language of the Regeneration cycle (harness: fence and gate).

Gate attempt3 rules · 23 scenariosOpen →

Aggregate GateAttempt, in the harness's event store: one per cycle and attempt number (event-model/gate-attempt.edn).

  • Install candidate in gate room The gate installs the regenerated candidate in a fresh gate room ORC chose
  • Record gate attempt The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin
  • Record gate refusal Gate refusals spend no attempt, and three in a row fail the cycle for infrastructure
Harness self check4 rules · 13 scenariosOpen →

Aggregate HarnessSelfCheck, in the harness's event store: one per cycle, occasion and attempt (event-model/harness-self-check.edn).

  • Record harness self check No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
  • Note pinned cut No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
  • Note golden written No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
  • Note golden moved No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
Regeneration cycle18 rules · 31 scenarios · 8 draftsOpen →

Aggregate RegenerationCycle, in the harness's event store: one per cycle identity (event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn).

  • Open cycle No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
  • Note failed self check A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score
  • Note clean room proved The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it
  • Note gate attempt passed The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin
  • Note gate attempt failed The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin
  • Note gate attempt refused Gate refusals spend no attempt, and three in a row fail the cycle for infrastructure
  • Note measurement filed The instrument's facts only conclude the cycle, and never feed the build loop
  • Note score stage failed A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason
  • Note scoreboard reported A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason
  • Record regenerated candidate A candidate is regenerated for the next gate attempt, within the budget
  • Conclude on failed self check A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score
  • Conclude on exhausted gate attempts A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason
  • Conclude on repeated gate refusals Gate refusals spend no attempt, and three in a row fail the cycle for infrastructure
  • Conclude on stage timeout A stage that outlives its timeout fails the cycle for its budget
  • Conclude on failed score stage A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason
  • Conclude on reported scoreboard A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason
  • Pass cycle A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason
  • Fail cycle A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason

Policies, timers, read models and queries

measurement · score-stage-failedmeasurement · scoreboard-reportedgate-attempt-failedgate-attempt-refusedharness-self-check-failedcycles-to-concludeto-do→conclude-cyclepolicy→fail-cyclepass-cycle

Whenever the scoreboard is reported after the measurement was filed, conclude the cycle passed; whenever a self-check failed (before the fence or before a gate attempt), the last gate attempt its budget allows failed, the gate refused three times in a row for infrastructure (R2 question 2), or its score stage failed, conclude it failed. Once per cycle.

clockevery:30, duration:seconds→stage-clocktimer→fail-cycle

Whenever a running cycle's stage (fence, regenerate, gate or score) outlives its timeout in the budget, fail the cycle at that stage with reason budget (decisions.md, R2 question 1). Gate refusals spend no attempt; this clock bounds them.

measurement · measurement-filedmeasurement · score-stage-failedmeasurement · scoreboard-reportedcycle-failedcycle-passedgate-attempt-failedgate-attempt-passedgate-attempt-refusedharness-self-check-failedharness-self-check-passed→cycles-to-concluderead model→cycles-to-concludequery

The conclude-cycle policy's to-do list: running cycles whose self-check failed, whose third gate attempt failed, whose gate refused three times in a row, whose score stage failed, or whose measurement is filed and scoreboard reported; a concluded cycle leaves it. A measurement filed or a score stage failed counts only for a cycle running at the score stage, and a scoreboard reported only for a running cycle whose measurement is filed (spec round 3).

candidate-installed-in-gate-roomcandidate-regeneratedgate-attempt-failedgate-attempt-passedgate-attempt-refused→gate-attemptsread model→cycle-progressquery

Each cycle's attempts: the candidate regenerated for it, whether it is installed, and the gate's verdict with its reason, boot margin and evidence root.

harness-self-check-failedharness-self-check-passed→harness-self-checksread model→

Each cycle's self-checks by occasion and attempt: outcome, harness, goldens and identity-probe digests, skipped checks. A gate attempt is recorded only over the passing one for its attempt, at the current goldens (H24).

grader-lifecycle · instrument-golden-movedgrader-lifecycle · instrument-golden-written→instrument-goldensread model→

The current digest of every instrument golden, with the digest of the scenario it was written from, and their combined goldens digest, which the self-check must reproduce.

cycle-preparation · source-cut-pinned→pinned-cutsread model→

The cuts Cycle preparation pinned; a cycle may only fence a pinned cut.

measurement · measurement-filedmeasurement · score-stage-failedmeasurement · scoreboard-reportedcandidate-installed-in-gate-roomcandidate-regeneratedclean-room-provedcycle-failedcycle-passedgate-attempt-failedgate-attempt-passedgate-attempt-refusedharness-self-check-failedharness-self-check-passed→regeneration-cyclesread model→cycle-progressquery

Each cycle: its cut, status and stage, its harness digest, clean room, current candidate and gate attempts, and its conclusion. Folded from its stage facts and the measurement's handoffs; a measurement filed or a score stage failed is folded only into a cycle running at the score stage, a scoreboard reported only into a running cycle whose measurement is filed (spec round 3).

The legacy cycle end to end: the harness self-checks, the fence proves the clean room, a candidate is regenerated, the gate ratifies it, the grader files item verdicts, the instrument files the measurement and reports the scoreboard, and the cycle concludes passed. The score and the scoreboard are Measurement's (its flow scoring): this flow stays inside this context and hears them as the handoffs measurement-filed and scoreboard-reported, which enter it from nil, as a command ORC runtime issues does, so its model validates alone with the handoffs it consumes (decisions.md, "Slice 04").

Before every gate attempt the harness self-checks again (decisions.md H24). A failed attempt that leaves attempts in the budget sends the cycle back to regenerate, where a repair room mounts only this cycle's gate evidence (H6), and the repaired candidate is installed in a fresh gate room. A gate refusal (seam answered before boot, identity probe missing or not the instrument's) records nothing and spends no attempt.

The boundary: what holds everywhere

The actors that may act (OrcRuntime, OrcRuntime, OrcRuntime, CyclePreparationContext, GraderLifecycleContext, OrcRuntime, Operator, BuilderSession, MeasurementContext), any contract every surface fulfils, and what others own.

outside the harnessOrcWorkerOrcWorkerOrcWorkerOrcWorker
ReproducesEveryGolden · The self-check runs the harness's calibration fixtures and reproduces every current instrument golden exactly, refusal reasons included; one that differs is a failing check, named.1 scenariocontract HarnessSelfCheckRun · @allium-boundary.ReproducesEveryGolden
@minimum@allium-boundary.ReproducesEveryGolden@item-04-003minimum
Scenario: A golden the harness self-check does not reproduce exactly fails it, by name
Given source cut K-3 was pinned
And the instrument golden "score-refusal" expects the refusal reason "unknown item"
And the tools at harness digest H-1 give the refusal reason "unknown id"
When ORC runtime runs the harness self-check of cycle C-7 before the fence
Then harness self-check failed is recorded for cycle C-7
And its failing check names the instrument golden "score-refusal"
.pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/spec.feature:36 · Rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
MissingToolIsALoudSkip · A tool the self-check cannot find in the tree it runs in (a scoring tool fenced out of the clean room, decisions.md H25) is a skip, listed by name in the recorded self-check, and does not fail it (legacy @harness-066: oracle exit 2, "SKIP" printed, run not failed). A skip nobody sees is a pass, so it is recorded.1 scenariocontract HarnessSelfCheckRun · @allium-boundary.MissingToolIsALoudSkip
@minimum@allium-boundary.MissingToolIsALoudSkip@item-04-007minimum
Scenario: A scoring tool fenced out of the clean room is a listed skip, not a failure
Given source cut K-3 was pinned
And the tree the harness self-check runs in has no scoring tool "score", because the fence removed it
When ORC runtime runs the harness self-check of cycle C-7 before the gate, attempt 1
Then harness self-check passed is recorded for cycle C-7 before the gate, attempt 1
And its skipped checks name "score"
.pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/spec.feature:83 · Rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence
GoldenRequiredWhereItsCycleExists · A golden the self-check needs is required: a recorded cycle with scores and no golden for its scoreboard, or an instrument scenario with no golden, is a missing golden, and a self-check with a missing golden cannot pass (legacy @harness-060, @harness-061). A golden with no cycle beside it is allowed: the fence deletes the cycles.2 scenarioscontract HarnessSelfCheckRun · @allium-boundary.GoldenRequiredWhereItsCycleExists
@minimum@allium-rule-failure.RecordHarnessSelfCheck.8@allium-boundary.GoldenRequiredWhereItsCycleExists@item-04-005minimum
Scenario: A cycle with scores and no scoreboard golden cannot pass the harness self-check
Given source cut K-3 was pinned
And source cut K-3 holds the scores of cycle 01 and no instrument golden for its scoreboard
When ORC runtime records the harness self-check of cycle C-7 before the fence, outcome passed, with missing golden "scoreboard-01"
Then the harness self-check is refused
And no regeneration cycle C-7 exists

And the clean room holds no cycle 01, because the fence removed it

Level 2 · spec cards · clean-room.allium in Regeneration cycle

Clean room

Aggregate CleanRoom, in the harness's event store: one per cycle (event-model/clean-room.edn). The fence is physical and proved, never asserted: one commit, every fenced path absent from the working tree AND the object graph, and a fenced path that matches nothing stops the fence. Legacy: fence.sh. A fence probe that does not hold is a refused ProveCleanRoom: no clean room exists, so nothing is recorded for it, and ORC's fence node then fails the cycle at the fence (FailCycle, reason fence_refused; decisions.md: a fence failure fails the cycle). The refusal codes keep the storm's names: "Fence refused: a fenced path matched nothing" (refusal 2) and "Fence refused: prior candidate reachable in the object graph" (refusal 6).

1 rules12 scenarios1 drafts13 obligations covered · 1 drafted · 0 uncovered

Rules

One card per rule: what it says in plain words, then the scenarios that show it. Drafts, not yet accepted, have a dashed amber edge. The Allium, the Grain block and the coverage of each card are under its hood.

rule

Prove clean room

10 examples · 1 happy path

The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

Record the probe of the clean room ORC's fence built from the cycle's cut: the probe's counts and the paths it found. Accepted only when the probe holds. Refusals 1-8 from R1; 9-10 added in R2.

Given
  • Regeneration cycle status is running
  • Issued by ORC runtime
When
Prove clean room
Refused if
  • The harness self-check before the fence did not pass (no cycle, or it failed) ✓ 04-009
  • A fenced path matched nothing (legacy: "FENCE FAILED: <p> matches nothing") ✓ 04-010
  • The room has more than one root commit ✓ 04-011
  • The room's history is not a single commit ✓ 04-012
  • A fenced path left in the working tree ✓ 04-013
  • A fenced path reachable in the object graph (the prior candidate) ✓ 04-014
  • Already proved ◇ unit test
  • The cut is not the self-checked cut ✓ 04-048
  • A scoring tool is not fenced: no grading harness in the room (H25) ✓ 04-015
  • The cycle is concluded ✓ 04-049
  • ✓ checked by an example · ◇ checked only by the code's own tests
Then
  • createsClean room
  • emitsClean room proved

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/clean-room.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/clean-room.edn
rule ProveCleanRoom {
    when: ProveCleanRoom(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, clean_room_commit, fenced_paths, root_commits, commits, unmatched_paths, paths_left_in_tree, paths_reachable_in_object_graph)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the harness self-check before the fence did not pass (no cycle, or it failed)
    requires: exists cycle and not cycle.self_check_failed
    -- 2. a fenced path matched nothing (legacy: "FENCE FAILED: <p> matches nothing")
    requires: unmatched_paths.count = 0
    -- 3. the room has more than one root commit
    requires: root_commits = 1
    -- 4. the room's history is not a single commit
    requires: commits = 1
    -- 5. a fenced path left in the working tree
    requires: paths_left_in_tree.count = 0
    -- 6. a fenced path reachable in the object graph (the prior candidate)
    requires: paths_reachable_in_object_graph.count = 0
    -- 7. already proved
    requires: not exists CleanRoom{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 8. the cut is not the self-checked cut
    requires: cut_id = cycle.cut_id
    -- 9. a scoring tool is not fenced: no grading harness in the room (H25)
    requires: ctx/config.scoring_tool_paths.all(t => t in fenced_paths)
    -- 10. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        CleanRoom.created(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, clean_room_commit: clean_room_commit, fenced_paths: fenced_paths, proved_at: now)
        CleanRoomProved(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, clean_room_commit: clean_room_commit, fenced_paths: fenced_paths)
}

Record the probe of the clean room ORC's fence built from the cycle's cut: the probe's counts and the paths it found. Accepted only when the probe holds. Issued by: ORC runtime (the fence node).

paths-reachable-in-object-graphlist of text
reads
regeneration-cycles
produces

Invariants and guarantees

What always holds, what a surface promises, and what a contract holds at the boundary, each with the scenarios that check it.

invariant

One clean room per cycle

1 example

Invariants

Level 2 · spec cards · context.allium in Regeneration cycle

Context

Scope: the shared language of the Regeneration cycle (harness: fence and gate). Every other file of the context uses this one and declares nothing it declares. One cycle in the legacy shape (archive/legacy-harness/README.md): fence -> regenerate -> gate -> score -> scoreboard -> result ORC runs the stages; the harness records what each stage did and guards it. A refused command records nothing: only what happened is an event (domain-design.md, decision 1). Aggregates (one file each; .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/): RegenerationCycle regeneration-cycle.allium stage order, budget, attempts, the one conclusion; the conclude-cycle policy HarnessSelfCheck harness-self-check.allium one per cycle, occasion and attempt CleanRoom clean-room.allium one per cycle; what the fence's probe found GateAttempt gate-attempt.allium one per cycle and attempt Handoffs consumed: cycle-preparation SourceCutPinned, grader-lifecycle InstrumentGoldenWritten and InstrumentGoldenMoved (harness-self-check.allium); measurement MeasurementFiled, ScoreStageFailed, ScoreboardReported, only to conclude (regeneration-cycle.allium). Produced: GateAttemptPassed, to measurement, one way (gate-attempt.allium). How the files meet: each aggregate emits its own events (HarnessSelfCheckPassed, CleanRoomProved, GateAttemptPassed, ...); regeneration-cycle.allium hears them by qualified name (`when: sc/HarnessSelfCheckPassed(...)`) and folds them into the cycle, as the regeneration-cycles read model does. The sibling files read the cycle through `use "regeneration-cycle.allium" as cyc`. Parties: each aggregate file declares the external entities and actors its surfaces face (ORC runtime, the operator, the builder host, the producing contexts), so that every external entity sits in a module that imports its context.

Level 2 · spec cards · gate-attempt.allium in Regeneration cycle

Gate attempt

Aggregate GateAttempt, in the harness's event store: one per cycle and attempt number (event-model/gate-attempt.edn). The claimant never controls the gate: a gate room ORC chose boots the candidate fresh through its launch entrypoint and proves its suite green. One verdict per attempt. Legacy: verify.sh and probe.sh. Two kinds of "no" (decisions.md b): - The gate ran and failed the attempt: a fact, GateAttemptFailed, with the first guard that did not hold as its reason. It spends the attempt; a repair builder may follow. - The gate refused to grade (infrastructure): the seam already answered before boot, the identity probe is missing or is not the instrument's, or no self-check passed for this attempt. A refusal records nothing and spends no attempt (legacy verify.sh exits before it boots). ORC then records that the gate refused (RecordGateRefusal), a fact that spends no attempt either; three in a row fail the cycle for infrastructure, and the gate stage's timeout bounds them (decisions.md, R2 question 2). GateAttemptRefused is the one exception to "refusals are requires, not events": a fact about the room, needed to count the refusals (decisions.md, Calls after R3, 1).

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule InstallCandidateInGateRoom {
    when: InstallCandidateInGateRoom(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, purpose, gate_room)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. no candidate regenerated for the attempt
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.attempts = attempt
    -- 2. another candidate digest
    requires: candidate_digest = cycle.candidate_digest
    -- 3. already installed
    requires: not exists GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        GateAttempt.created(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, purpose: purpose, gate_room: gate_room, verdict: awaiting, last_refusal: null)
        CandidateInstalledInGateRoom(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, gate_room: gate_room)
}

rule

Record gate attempt

14 examples · 2 happy paths

The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

Record the gate's verdict on one attempt: passed (seam free before boot, contract present, suites discovered and green, answered within the boot budget, identity proved) or failed with the first guard that did not hold. Refusals 1-5 from R1; 6-11 added in R2; 12 added in R2.1 (R2 question 4).

Given
  • Issued by ORC runtime
When
Record gate attempt
Refused if
  • Not installed ✓ 04-053
  • Already has a verdict: a replay records nothing and spends no attempt (H1) ✓ 04-031
  • Failed without a reason, or passed with one ✓ 04-054
  • Passed without the poll that answered and the identity probe result ✓ 04-055
  • Answered after the last poll of the budget ✓ 04-056
  • Another candidate than the one installed ✓ 04-057
  • No self-check passed for this attempt, at this harness and the current goldens (H24) ✓ 04-020
  • The identity probe is missing: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh; "to add" 3) ✓ 04-021
  • The identity probe is not the instrument's, the one the self-check checked ("to add" 4) ✓ 04-022
  • The seam answered before boot: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh [1]; b) ✓ 04-032
  • The cycle is concluded ✓ 04-058
  • The self-check ran at other approved grader digests than these: its key covers them (R2 question 4) ✓ 04-059
Then
  • emitsGate attempt failed (in some cases)
  • updatesGate boot budget seconds → boot budget seconds (in some cases)
  • updatesGate reason → reason (in some cases)
  • updatesGate evidence root → evidence root (in some cases)
  • updatesGate verdict → gate passed (in some cases)
  • updatesGate verdict → gate failed (in some cases)
  • updatesGate boot polls → boot polls (in some cases)
  • updatesGate answered on poll → answered on poll (in some cases)
  • emitsGate attempt passed → Measurement (in some cases)

rule RecordGateAttempt {
    when: RecordGateAttempt(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, harness_digest, outcome, reason?, boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls, answered_on_poll?, identity_probe_result?, identity_probe_present, identity_probe_digest, seam_answered_before_boot, evidence_root, detail, grader_digests)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let check = sc.HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: before_gate, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a replay records nothing and spends no attempt (H1)
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. failed without a reason, or passed with one
    requires: (outcome = gate_failed implies reason != null) and (outcome = gate_passed implies reason = null)
    -- 4. passed without the poll that answered and the identity probe result
    requires: outcome = gate_passed implies (answered_on_poll != null and identity_probe_result != null)
    -- 5. answered after the last poll of the budget
    requires: answered_on_poll != null implies answered_on_poll <= boot_polls
    -- 6. another candidate than the one installed
    requires: candidate_digest = gate.candidate_digest
    -- 7. no self-check passed for this attempt, at this harness and the current goldens (H24)
    requires: exists check and check.outcome = check_passed and check.harness_digest = harness_digest and check.at_current_goldens
    -- 8. the identity probe is missing: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh; "to add" 3)
    requires: identity_probe_present
    -- 9. the identity probe is not the instrument's, the one the self-check checked ("to add" 4)
    requires: identity_probe_digest = check.identity_probe_digest
    -- 10. the seam answered before boot: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh [1]; b)
    requires: not seam_answered_before_boot
    -- 11. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    -- 12. the self-check ran at other approved grader digests than these: its key covers
    --     them (R2 question 4)
    requires: check.grader_digests = grader_digests
    ensures:
        if outcome = gate_passed:
            gate.verdict = gate_passed
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.answered_on_poll = answered_on_poll
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cycle.cut_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, answered_on_poll: answered_on_poll, identity_probe_result: identity_probe_result, evidence_root: evidence_root)
        else:
            gate.verdict = gate_failed
            gate.reason = reason
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, reason: reason, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, evidence_root: evidence_root, detail: detail)
}
record-gate-attemptCommand · :regeneration-cycle

rule RecordGateRefusal {
    when: RecordGateRefusal(orc, cycle_id, attempt, refusal, detail)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a refusal is never recorded over a verdict
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        gate.last_refusal = refusal
        GateAttemptRefused(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

Allium source.pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium
entity GateAttempt {
    cycle_id: String
    attempt: Integer
    candidate_digest: String
    purpose: ctx.CandidatePurpose
    gate_room: String
    verdict: awaiting | gate_passed | gate_failed
    reason: ctx.GateFailureReason when verdict = gate_failed
    boot_budget_seconds: Integer when verdict = gate_passed | gate_failed
    boot_polls: Integer when verdict = gate_passed | gate_failed
    answered_on_poll: Integer when verdict = gate_passed
    evidence_root: String when verdict = gate_passed | gate_failed
    -- The last refusal to grade this attempt, if any (R2 question 2).
    last_refusal: ctx.GateRefusal?

    -- The boot margin, said out loud on a green run (legacy @harness-056).
    boot_margin_polls: boot_polls - answered_on_poll

    transitions verdict {
        awaiting -> gate_passed
        awaiting -> gate_failed
        terminal: gate_passed, gate_failed
    }
}

Level 2 · spec cards · harness-self-check.allium in Regeneration cycle

Harness self check

Aggregate HarnessSelfCheck, in the harness's event store: one per cycle, occasion and attempt (event-model/harness-self-check.edn). No clean room is built, and no candidate is graded, over an unchecked instrument. The self-check runs before the fence and again before every gate attempt, as the legacy harness does (decisions.md H24; legacy fence.sh and verify.sh both call check.sh --local first, @harness-065). The two handoffs it reads arrive here: the pinned cuts (a cycle fences only a pinned cut) and the instrument goldens (the self-check must reproduce the current ones).

4 rules13 scenarios0 drafts16 obligations covered · 0 drafted · 0 uncovered

Rules

One card per rule: what it says in plain words, then the scenarios that show it. Drafts, not yet accepted, have a dashed amber edge. The Allium, the Grain block and the coverage of each card are under its hood.

rule

Record harness self check

10 examples · 1 happy path

No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

Record the result of the harness self-check run for a cycle. Issued by ORC runtime: its fence node first in the cycle, and its gate node before every gate attempt. Refusals 1-4 from R1; 5-8 added in R2 (H24, H5, the legacy golden check); 9-10 added in R2.1 (the reworded golden, R2 question 5). The self-check carries the approved grader digests it ran at (R2 question 4).

Given
  • Issued by ORC runtime
When
Record harness self check
Refused if
  • The cut is not pinned ✓ 04-041
  • The goldens digest is not the current goldens ✓ 04-002
  • Already recorded for this cycle, occasion and attempt (a replay records nothing) ◇ unit test
  • Failed without naming the failing check ✓ 04-042
  • Before the fence: the cycle's first fact, attempt 0 ✓ 04-043
  • Before a gate attempt: the running cycle of this cut, with the attempt's candidate ✓ 04-004
  • The preparation's budget, within AGENTS.md's limits (H5) ✓ 04-045
  • A self-check with a missing golden cannot pass (legacy @harness-060, @harness-061) ✓ 04-005
  • A self-check with a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written cannot pass: the fix is to re-record the golden with a logged reason ✓ 04-028

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/harness-self-check.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/harness-self-check.edn
rule RecordHarnessSelfCheck {
    when: RecordHarnessSelfCheck(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, occasion, attempt, harness_digest, goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest, outcome, failing_check?, detail?, skipped_checks, missing_goldens, budget, grader_digests, reworded_goldens)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. the goldens digest is not the current goldens
    requires: goldens_digest = goldens_digest_of(CurrentGoldens)
    -- 3. already recorded for this cycle, occasion and attempt (a replay records nothing)
    requires: not exists HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. failed without naming the failing check
    requires: outcome = check_failed implies failing_check != null
    -- 5. before the fence: the cycle's first fact, attempt 0
    requires: occasion = before_fence implies (not exists cycle and attempt = 0)
    -- 6. before a gate attempt: the running cycle of this cut, with the attempt's candidate
    requires: occasion = before_gate implies (exists cycle and cycle.status = running and cycle.cut_id = cut_id and cycle.attempts = attempt)
    -- 7. the preparation's budget, within AGENTS.md's limits (H5)
    requires: budget.gate_attempt_limit >= 1 and budget.gate_attempt_limit <= 3 and budget.max_continuations <= 3
    -- 8. a self-check with a missing golden cannot pass (legacy @harness-060, @harness-061)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies missing_goldens.count = 0
    -- 9. a self-check with a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written cannot
    --    pass: the fix is to re-record the golden with a logged reason (decisions.md h; R2
    --    question 5)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies reworded_goldens.count = 0
    -- 10. a reworded golden is not one of the current goldens whose scenario digest moved
    requires: reworded_goldens.all(g => exists CurrentGolden{golden_id: g})
    ensures:
        HarnessSelfCheck.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            cut_id: cut_id,
            occasion: occasion,
            attempt: attempt,
            harness_digest: harness_digest,
            goldens_digest: goldens_digest,
            grader_digests: grader_digests,
            identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest,
            outcome: outcome,
            failing_check: failing_check,
            skipped_checks: skipped_checks,
            checked_at: now
        )
        if outcome = check_passed:
            HarnessSelfCheckPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, goldens_digest: goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest, skipped_checks: skipped_checks, budget: budget, grader_digests: grader_digests)
        else:
            HarnessSelfCheckFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, failing_check: failing_check, detail: detail, budget: budget, reworded_goldens: reworded_goldens)
}
record-harness-self-checkCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the result of the harness self-check run for a cycle: the harness's calibration fixtures, every instrument golden reproduced exactly, the committed revision and runtime assets, the identity probe. A failed check is named; a tool not found is a listed skip; a missing golden, or a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written, fails it (R2 question 5). Keyed on the harness digest, the goldens digest and the approved grader digests (R2 question 4). Issued by: ORC runtime, the fence node first in the cycle (occasion before-fence, attempt 0, with the preparation's budget) and the gate node before every gate attempt (occasion before-gate).

invariant OneSelfCheckPerOccasion {

}

entity HarnessSelfCheck {
    cycle_id: String
    cut_id: String
    occasion: ctx.SelfCheckOccasion
    -- 0 before the fence; the gate attempt it precedes otherwise.
    attempt: Integer
    harness_digest: String
    goldens_digest: String
    -- The approved grader digests the self-check ran at: part of its key (R2 question 4).
    grader_digests: Set<String>
    -- The identity probe the self-check checked: the instrument's, not the candidate's.
    identity_probe_digest: String
    outcome: check_passed | check_failed
    failing_check: String?
    -- Tools the run could not find: loud skips, listed, not failures.
    skipped_checks: Set<String>
    checked_at: Timestamp

    -- Never reused across a change of the goldens (decisions.md H24).
    at_current_goldens: goldens_digest = goldens_digest_of(CurrentGoldens)
}
entity PinnedCut {
    cut_id: String
    commit: String
    tree_digest: String
}
entity CurrentGolden {
    golden_id: String
    digest: String
    scenario_digest: String
}

Level 2 · spec cards · regeneration-cycle.allium in Regeneration cycle

Regeneration cycle

Aggregate RegenerationCycle, in the harness's event store: one per cycle identity (event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn). It owns the stage order, the budget, the attempt count and the one conclusion. Its facts arrive from the sibling aggregates (self-check, clean room, gate attempt) and from measurement's handoffs; it folds them the way the regeneration-cycles read model does, and the conclude-cycle policy reads the result. The cycle identity is given in the core and minted at submission later (decisions.md H8): a cycle exists from its first self-check, passed or failed, and a cycle that fails before the score exists and has no score. Legacy: the shape of archive/legacy-harness (fence.sh, verify.sh, score.clj, scoreboard.clj), one cycle per week, with the gate attempts and the repair builder of AGENTS.md.

rule OpenCycle {
    when: sc/HarnessSelfCheckPassed(cycle_id, cut_id, occasion, attempt, harness_digest, goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest, skipped_checks, budget)
    requires: occasion = before_fence
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    ensures: RegenerationCycle.created(
        cycle_id: cycle_id,
        cut_id: cut_id,
        budget: budget,
        harness_digest: harness_digest,
        status: running,
        stage: fence,
        stage_entered_at: now,
        clean_room_proved: false,
        attempts: 0,
        failed_attempts: 0,
        candidate_digest: null,
        gate_evidence_roots: {},
        consecutive_gate_refusals: 0,
        self_check_failed: false,
        self_check_failure: null,
        measurement_filed: false,
        score_stage_failed: false,
        scoreboard_reported: false
    )
}
rule

Note failed self check

1 example · 1 happy path

A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score

A failed self-check is the cycle's fact either way. Before the fence it opens the cycle, so that the cycle exists, fails at the fence and shows as "no score"; no room is built over it. Before a gate attempt it marks the running cycle: nothing is booted or graded and no attempt is spent, and the cycle fails at the gate (legacy verify.sh [0], @harness-065).

Given
nothing before it: it starts the lifecycle
When
Note failed self check
Refused if
  • The cycle exists before the fence, or not before a gate attempt; guarded by: RecordHarnessSelfCheck.5, RecordHarnessSelfCheck.6 (the self-check refuses both) ◇ unit test
Then
  • createsRegeneration cycle (in some cases)
  • updatesRegeneration cycle self check failed → true (in some cases)
  • updatesRegeneration cycle self check failure → failing check (in some cases)
Examples
A failed harness self-check before the fence fails the cycle at the fence with no scorehappy path
Given cut K-3 was pinned
When ORC runtime records a failed harness self-check before the fence for cycle C-7, naming the check "instrument golden scoreboard-arithmetic"
Then cycle C-7 exists and fails at the fence stage with reason harness self-check failed, naming that check
And no clean room is proved for cycle C-7
And the cycle progress view shows cycle C-7 as "no score", never as every item failed
covers 3 obligations
  • success Note failed self check
  • invariant Failed before score has no measurement
  • guarantee No score is not all failed

.pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/spec.feature:269 · Rule: A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score
Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium
rule NoteFailedSelfCheck {
    when: sc/HarnessSelfCheckFailed(cycle_id, cut_id, occasion, attempt, harness_digest, failing_check, detail, budget)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists before the fence, or not before a gate attempt; guarded by:
    --    RecordHarnessSelfCheck.5, RecordHarnessSelfCheck.6 (the self-check refuses both)
    requires: (occasion = before_fence implies not exists cycle) and (occasion = before_gate implies exists cycle)
    ensures:
        if occasion = before_fence:
            RegenerationCycle.created(
                cycle_id: cycle_id,
                cut_id: cut_id,
                budget: budget,
                harness_digest: harness_digest,
                status: running,
                stage: fence,
                stage_entered_at: now,
                clean_room_proved: false,
                attempts: 0,
                failed_attempts: 0,
                candidate_digest: null,
                gate_evidence_roots: {},
                consecutive_gate_refusals: 0,
                self_check_failed: true,
                self_check_failure: failing_check,
                measurement_filed: false,
                score_stage_failed: false,
                scoreboard_reported: false
            )
        else:
            cycle.self_check_failed = true
            cycle.self_check_failure = failing_check
}

    when: gate/GateAttemptFailed(cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, reason, boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls, evidence_root, detail)

    -- 1. no such cycle; guarded by: RecordGateAttempt.11 (a verdict is recorded only for an

        cycle.failed_attempts = cycle.failed_attempts + 1
        cycle.gate_evidence_roots = cycle.gate_evidence_roots + {evidence_root}
        cycle.consecutive_gate_refusals = 0
        if cycle.failed_attempts < cycle.budget.gate_attempt_limit:
            cycle.stage = regenerate
            cycle.stage_entered_at = now
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule RecordRegeneratedCandidate {
    when: RecordRegeneratedCandidate(orc, cycle_id, attempt, purpose, candidate_digest, parent_candidate_digest?, mounted_evidence)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. no clean room proved
    requires: cycle.clean_room_proved
    -- 3. the attempt is the next one
    requires: attempt = cycle.attempts + 1
    -- 4. within the budget's gate-attempt limit, at most three (H5, AGENTS.md)
    requires: attempt <= cycle.budget.gate_attempt_limit
    -- 5. fresh generation for attempt 1, verification repair after
    requires: (attempt = 1 implies purpose = fresh_generation) and (attempt > 1 implies purpose = verification_repair)
    -- 6. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    -- 7. a repair follows a failed gate attempt, never a passed one
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate and cycle.failed_attempts = attempt - 1
    -- 8. a repair's parent is not the previous candidate
    requires: purpose = verification_repair implies parent_candidate_digest = cycle.candidate_digest
    -- 9. only a repair room mounts evidence, and only this cycle's gate evidence (H6)
    requires: (purpose = fresh_generation implies mounted_evidence.count = 0) and mounted_evidence.all(e => e in cycle.gate_evidence_roots)
    ensures:
        cycle.attempts = attempt
        cycle.candidate_digest = candidate_digest
        cycle.stage = gate
        cycle.stage_entered_at = now
        CandidateRegenerated(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, purpose: purpose, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, parent_candidate_digest: parent_candidate_digest)
}
record-regenerated-candidateCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the candidate a regenerate step produced in the cycle's candidate scope, for the next gate attempt, within the budget's gate-attempt limit: attempt 1 by fresh generation, later attempts by verification repair after a failed attempt, whose room mounted only this cycle's gate evidence (H6). A claim, not done. Issued by: ORC runtime (the regenerate node).

Conclude on failed self check

1 example · 1 happy path

A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score

Whenever a self-check failed (before the fence or before a gate attempt), fail the cycle at the stage it reached.

Given
  • Regeneration cycle status is running
When
Conclude on failed self check
Refused if
  • Not yet written in words cycle.status = running ◇ unit test
Then
  • emitsFail cycle

And the cycle progress view still shows 1 failed gate attempt

no example yet · 3 drafts · happy path only in a draft

A stage that outlives its timeout fails the cycle for its budget

The stage clock: whenever a running cycle's stage outlives its timeout in the budget, fail the cycle at that stage for its budget (R2 question 1). Gate refusals are bounded here too: they spend no attempt, but the gate stage's clock keeps running (question 2).

When
Time passes (a deadline is reached)
Refused if

  • emitsFail cycle

rule PassCycle {
    when: PassCycle(cycle_id)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. the measurement is not filed or the scoreboard is not reported
    requires: cycle.measurement_filed and cycle.scoreboard_reported
    -- 3. already concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        cycle.status = cycle_passed
        cycle.stage = result
        CyclePassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, candidate_digest: cycle.candidate_digest)
}

Conclude the cycle failed, once, at a named stage for a named reason. Issued by the conclude-cycle policy, or by ORC when a stage node's command was refused (the fence) or the node produced nothing (regenerate), or by the stage clock. Refusals 1-2 from R1; 3-4 added in R2; 5 added in R2.1.

  • The reason does not belong to the stage ✓ 04-074

  • ✓ checked by an example · ○ only in a draft example · ◇ checked only by the code's own tests
Then
  • updatesRegeneration cycle status → cycle failed

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule FailCycle {
    when: FailCycle(cycle_id, stage, reason, detail)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. already concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    -- 3. the stage is not the one the cycle reached
    requires: stage = cycle.stage
    -- 4. the reason does not belong to the stage
    requires:
        (reason = fence_refused implies stage = fence)
        and (reason = candidate_not_regenerated implies stage = regenerate)
        and (reason = gate_attempts_exhausted implies stage = gate)
        and (reason = score_stage_failed implies stage = score)
    -- 5. an infrastructure failure is not at the gate
    requires: reason = infrastructure implies stage = gate
    ensures:
        cycle.status = cycle_failed
        cycle.failed_stage = stage
        cycle.failure_reason = reason
        cycle.failure_detail = detail
        CycleFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, stage: stage, reason: reason, detail: detail, candidate_digest: cycle.candidate_digest)
}
fail-cycleCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Conclude the cycle failed, once, naming the stage and the reason. Issued by: the conclude-cycle policy (self-check failed, gate attempts exhausted, three consecutive gate refusals for infrastructure, score stage failed), the stage clock (a stage outlived its timeout in the budget: reason budget, R2 question 1), or ORC runtime when a stage node fails because its command was refused (the fence) or it produced nothing (regenerate).

Allium source.pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium
entity RegenerationCycle {
    cycle_id: String
    cut_id: String
    budget: ctx.Budget
    -- The harness digest of the self-check before the fence.
    harness_digest: String
    status: running | cycle_passed | cycle_failed
    -- The stage reached: fence, regenerate, gate, score, scoreboard; result once passed.
    stage: ctx.Stage
    -- When the cycle entered its stage: the stage clock runs from here (R2 question 1).
    stage_entered_at: Timestamp
    clean_room_proved: Boolean
    -- Candidates regenerated so far; the latest is the current attempt.
    attempts: Integer
    failed_attempts: Integer
    candidate_digest: String?
    -- Gate evidence of this cycle's failed attempts: the only evidence a repair room may
    -- mount (decisions.md H6).
    gate_evidence_roots: Set<String>
    -- Gate refusals since the last verdict: a refusal spends no attempt, but three in a
    -- row fail the cycle (R2 question 2).
    consecutive_gate_refusals: Integer
    self_check_failed: Boolean
    self_check_failure: String?
    measurement_filed: Boolean
    score_stage_failed: Boolean
    scoreboard_reported: Boolean
    failed_stage: ctx.Stage when status = cycle_failed
    failure_reason: ctx.FailureReason when status = cycle_failed
    failure_detail: String when status = cycle_failed

    -- Gate attempts exhausted is a read-model fact, not an event (domain-design.md, 7).
    attempts_exhausted: failed_attempts >= budget.gate_attempt_limit

    -- The stage's timeout of the budget runs out here (R2 question 1).
    stage_deadline: stage_entered_at + timeout_of(budget, stage)

    -- The conclude-cycle policy's to-do list (cycles-to-conclude).
    awaits_failing_self_check: status = running and self_check_failed
    awaits_failing_gate: status = running and attempts_exhausted
    awaits_failing_infrastructure: status = running and consecutive_gate_refusals >= ctx/config.max_consecutive_gate_refusals
    awaits_failing_score: status = running and score_stage_failed
    awaits_passing: status = running and measurement_filed and scoreboard_reported

    transitions status {
        running -> cycle_passed
        running -> cycle_failed
        terminal: cycle_passed, cycle_failed
    }
}

Command in :regeneration-cycle · aggregate Gate attempt

record-gate-attempt

Record the gate's verdict on one attempt: passed (the contract present, suites discovered and green, answered within the boot budget, the identity probe proved it is this application) or failed with the first guard that did not hold. Refused, recording nothing and spending no attempt, when no self-check passed for the attempt at these approved grader digests (R2 question 4), the identity probe is missing or is not the instrument's, or the seam answered before boot (decisions.md b). Issued by: ORC runtime (the gate node), from the gate room's result.

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule RecordGateAttempt {
    when: RecordGateAttempt(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, harness_digest, outcome, reason?, boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls, answered_on_poll?, identity_probe_result?, identity_probe_present, identity_probe_digest, seam_answered_before_boot, evidence_root, detail, grader_digests)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let check = sc.HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: before_gate, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a replay records nothing and spends no attempt (H1)
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. failed without a reason, or passed with one
    requires: (outcome = gate_failed implies reason != null) and (outcome = gate_passed implies reason = null)
    -- 4. passed without the poll that answered and the identity probe result
    requires: outcome = gate_passed implies (answered_on_poll != null and identity_probe_result != null)
    -- 5. answered after the last poll of the budget
    requires: answered_on_poll != null implies answered_on_poll <= boot_polls
    -- 6. another candidate than the one installed
    requires: candidate_digest = gate.candidate_digest
    -- 7. no self-check passed for this attempt, at this harness and the current goldens (H24)
    requires: exists check and check.outcome = check_passed and check.harness_digest = harness_digest and check.at_current_goldens
    -- 8. the identity probe is missing: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh; "to add" 3)
    requires: identity_probe_present
    -- 9. the identity probe is not the instrument's, the one the self-check checked ("to add" 4)
    requires: identity_probe_digest = check.identity_probe_digest
    -- 10. the seam answered before boot: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh [1]; b)
    requires: not seam_answered_before_boot
    -- 11. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    -- 12. the self-check ran at other approved grader digests than these: its key covers
    --     them (R2 question 4)
    requires: check.grader_digests = grader_digests
    ensures:
        if outcome = gate_passed:
            gate.verdict = gate_passed
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.answered_on_poll = answered_on_poll
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cycle.cut_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, answered_on_poll: answered_on_poll, identity_probe_result: identity_probe_result, evidence_root: evidence_root)
        else:
            gate.verdict = gate_failed
            gate.reason = reason
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, reason: reason, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, evidence_root: evidence_root, detail: detail)
}

Whenever a running cycle's stage (fence, regenerate, gate or score) outlives its timeout in the budget, fail the cycle at that stage with reason budget (decisions.md, R2 question 1). Gate refusals spend no attempt; this clock bounds them.

rule ConcludeOnStageTimeout {
    when: cycle: RegenerationCycle.stage_deadline <= now
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage in {fence, regenerate, gate, score}
    ensures: FailCycle(cycle_id: cycle.cycle_id, stage: cycle.stage, reason: budget, detail: "stage timeout")
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule RecordGateAttempt {
    when: RecordGateAttempt(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, harness_digest, outcome, reason?, boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls, answered_on_poll?, identity_probe_result?, identity_probe_present, identity_probe_digest, seam_answered_before_boot, evidence_root, detail, grader_digests)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let check = sc.HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: before_gate, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a replay records nothing and spends no attempt (H1)
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. failed without a reason, or passed with one
    requires: (outcome = gate_failed implies reason != null) and (outcome = gate_passed implies reason = null)
    -- 4. passed without the poll that answered and the identity probe result
    requires: outcome = gate_passed implies (answered_on_poll != null and identity_probe_result != null)
    -- 5. answered after the last poll of the budget
    requires: answered_on_poll != null implies answered_on_poll <= boot_polls
    -- 6. another candidate than the one installed
    requires: candidate_digest = gate.candidate_digest
    -- 7. no self-check passed for this attempt, at this harness and the current goldens (H24)
    requires: exists check and check.outcome = check_passed and check.harness_digest = harness_digest and check.at_current_goldens
    -- 8. the identity probe is missing: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh; "to add" 3)
    requires: identity_probe_present
    -- 9. the identity probe is not the instrument's, the one the self-check checked ("to add" 4)
    requires: identity_probe_digest = check.identity_probe_digest
    -- 10. the seam answered before boot: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh [1]; b)
    requires: not seam_answered_before_boot
    -- 11. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    -- 12. the self-check ran at other approved grader digests than these: its key covers
    --     them (R2 question 4)
    requires: check.grader_digests = grader_digests
    ensures:
        if outcome = gate_passed:
            gate.verdict = gate_passed
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.answered_on_poll = answered_on_poll
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cycle.cut_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, answered_on_poll: answered_on_poll, identity_probe_result: identity_probe_result, evidence_root: evidence_root)
        else:
            gate.verdict = gate_failed
            gate.reason = reason
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, reason: reason, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, evidence_root: evidence_root, detail: detail)
}
record-gate-attemptCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the gate's verdict on one attempt: passed (the contract present, suites discovered and green, answered within the boot budget, the identity probe proved it is this application) or failed with the first guard that did not hold. Refused, recording nothing and spending no attempt, when no self-check passed for the attempt at these approved grader digests (R2 question 4), the identity probe is missing or is not the instrument's, or the seam answered before boot (decisions.md b). Issued by: ORC runtime (the gate node), from the gate room's result.

Read model in :regeneration-cycle · aggregate Regeneration cycle

cycles-to-conclude

The conclude-cycle policy's to-do list: running cycles whose self-check failed, whose third gate attempt failed, whose gate refused three times in a row, whose score stage failed, or whose measurement is filed and scoreboard reported; a concluded cycle leaves it. A measurement filed or a score stage failed counts only for a cycle running at the score stage, and a scoreboard reported only for a running cycle whose measurement is filed (spec round 3).

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule InstallCandidateInGateRoom {
    when: InstallCandidateInGateRoom(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, purpose, gate_room)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. no candidate regenerated for the attempt
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.attempts = attempt
    -- 2. another candidate digest
    requires: candidate_digest = cycle.candidate_digest
    -- 3. already installed
    requires: not exists GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        GateAttempt.created(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, purpose: purpose, gate_room: gate_room, verdict: awaiting, last_refusal: null)
        CandidateInstalledInGateRoom(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, gate_room: gate_room)
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule RecordGateRefusal {
    when: RecordGateRefusal(orc, cycle_id, attempt, refusal, detail)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a refusal is never recorded over a verdict
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        gate.last_refusal = refusal
        GateAttemptRefused(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule RecordRegeneratedCandidate {
    when: RecordRegeneratedCandidate(orc, cycle_id, attempt, purpose, candidate_digest, parent_candidate_digest?, mounted_evidence)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. no clean room proved
    requires: cycle.clean_room_proved
    -- 3. the attempt is the next one
    requires: attempt = cycle.attempts + 1
    -- 4. within the budget's gate-attempt limit, at most three (H5, AGENTS.md)
    requires: attempt <= cycle.budget.gate_attempt_limit
    -- 5. fresh generation for attempt 1, verification repair after
    requires: (attempt = 1 implies purpose = fresh_generation) and (attempt > 1 implies purpose = verification_repair)
    -- 6. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    -- 7. a repair follows a failed gate attempt, never a passed one
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate and cycle.failed_attempts = attempt - 1
    -- 8. a repair's parent is not the previous candidate
    requires: purpose = verification_repair implies parent_candidate_digest = cycle.candidate_digest
    -- 9. only a repair room mounts evidence, and only this cycle's gate evidence (H6)
    requires: (purpose = fresh_generation implies mounted_evidence.count = 0) and mounted_evidence.all(e => e in cycle.gate_evidence_roots)
    ensures:
        cycle.attempts = attempt
        cycle.candidate_digest = candidate_digest
        cycle.stage = gate
        cycle.stage_entered_at = now
        CandidateRegenerated(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, purpose: purpose, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, parent_candidate_digest: parent_candidate_digest)
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule RecordGateAttempt {
    when: RecordGateAttempt(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, harness_digest, outcome, reason?, boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls, answered_on_poll?, identity_probe_result?, identity_probe_present, identity_probe_digest, seam_answered_before_boot, evidence_root, detail, grader_digests)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let check = sc.HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: before_gate, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a replay records nothing and spends no attempt (H1)
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. failed without a reason, or passed with one
    requires: (outcome = gate_failed implies reason != null) and (outcome = gate_passed implies reason = null)
    -- 4. passed without the poll that answered and the identity probe result
    requires: outcome = gate_passed implies (answered_on_poll != null and identity_probe_result != null)
    -- 5. answered after the last poll of the budget
    requires: answered_on_poll != null implies answered_on_poll <= boot_polls
    -- 6. another candidate than the one installed
    requires: candidate_digest = gate.candidate_digest
    -- 7. no self-check passed for this attempt, at this harness and the current goldens (H24)
    requires: exists check and check.outcome = check_passed and check.harness_digest = harness_digest and check.at_current_goldens
    -- 8. the identity probe is missing: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh; "to add" 3)
    requires: identity_probe_present
    -- 9. the identity probe is not the instrument's, the one the self-check checked ("to add" 4)
    requires: identity_probe_digest = check.identity_probe_digest
    -- 10. the seam answered before boot: the gate refuses to grade (legacy verify.sh [1]; b)
    requires: not seam_answered_before_boot
    -- 11. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    -- 12. the self-check ran at other approved grader digests than these: its key covers
    --     them (R2 question 4)
    requires: check.grader_digests = grader_digests
    ensures:
        if outcome = gate_passed:
            gate.verdict = gate_passed
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.answered_on_poll = answered_on_poll
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cycle.cut_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, answered_on_poll: answered_on_poll, identity_probe_result: identity_probe_result, evidence_root: evidence_root)
        else:
            gate.verdict = gate_failed
            gate.reason = reason
            gate.boot_budget_seconds = boot_budget_seconds
            gate.boot_polls = boot_polls
            gate.evidence_root = evidence_root
            GateAttemptFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, reason: reason, boot_budget_seconds: boot_budget_seconds, boot_polls: boot_polls, evidence_root: evidence_root, detail: detail)
}
record-gate-attemptCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the gate's verdict on one attempt: passed (the contract present, suites discovered and green, answered within the boot budget, the identity probe proved it is this application) or failed with the first guard that did not hold. Refused, recording nothing and spending no attempt, when no self-check passed for the attempt at these approved grader digests (R2 question 4), the identity probe is missing or is not the instrument's, or the seam answered before boot (decisions.md b). Issued by: ORC runtime (the gate node), from the gate room's result.

Command in :regeneration-cycle · aggregate Harness self check

record-harness-self-check

Record the result of the harness self-check run for a cycle: the harness's calibration fixtures, every instrument golden reproduced exactly, the committed revision and runtime assets, the identity probe. A failed check is named; a tool not found is a listed skip; a missing golden, or a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written, fails it (R2 question 5). Keyed on the harness digest, the goldens digest and the approved grader digests (R2 question 4). Issued by: ORC runtime, the fence node first in the cycle (occasion before-fence, attempt 0, with the preparation's budget) and the gate node before every gate attempt (occasion before-gate).

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/harness-self-check.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/harness-self-check.edn
rule RecordHarnessSelfCheck {
    when: RecordHarnessSelfCheck(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, occasion, attempt, harness_digest, goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest, outcome, failing_check?, detail?, skipped_checks, missing_goldens, budget, grader_digests, reworded_goldens)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. the goldens digest is not the current goldens
    requires: goldens_digest = goldens_digest_of(CurrentGoldens)
    -- 3. already recorded for this cycle, occasion and attempt (a replay records nothing)
    requires: not exists HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. failed without naming the failing check
    requires: outcome = check_failed implies failing_check != null
    -- 5. before the fence: the cycle's first fact, attempt 0
    requires: occasion = before_fence implies (not exists cycle and attempt = 0)
    -- 6. before a gate attempt: the running cycle of this cut, with the attempt's candidate
    requires: occasion = before_gate implies (exists cycle and cycle.status = running and cycle.cut_id = cut_id and cycle.attempts = attempt)
    -- 7. the preparation's budget, within AGENTS.md's limits (H5)
    requires: budget.gate_attempt_limit >= 1 and budget.gate_attempt_limit <= 3 and budget.max_continuations <= 3
    -- 8. a self-check with a missing golden cannot pass (legacy @harness-060, @harness-061)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies missing_goldens.count = 0
    -- 9. a self-check with a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written cannot
    --    pass: the fix is to re-record the golden with a logged reason (decisions.md h; R2
    --    question 5)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies reworded_goldens.count = 0
    -- 10. a reworded golden is not one of the current goldens whose scenario digest moved
    requires: reworded_goldens.all(g => exists CurrentGolden{golden_id: g})
    ensures:
        HarnessSelfCheck.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            cut_id: cut_id,
            occasion: occasion,
            attempt: attempt,
            harness_digest: harness_digest,
            goldens_digest: goldens_digest,
            grader_digests: grader_digests,
            identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest,
            outcome: outcome,
            failing_check: failing_check,
            skipped_checks: skipped_checks,
            checked_at: now
        )
        if outcome = check_passed:
            HarnessSelfCheckPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, goldens_digest: goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest, skipped_checks: skipped_checks, budget: budget, grader_digests: grader_digests)
        else:
            HarnessSelfCheckFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, failing_check: failing_check, detail: detail, budget: budget, reworded_goldens: reworded_goldens)
}
record-harness-self-checkCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the result of the harness self-check run for a cycle: the harness's calibration fixtures, every instrument golden reproduced exactly, the committed revision and runtime assets, the identity probe. A failed check is named; a tool not found is a listed skip; a missing golden, or a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written, fails it (R2 question 5). Keyed on the harness digest, the goldens digest and the approved grader digests (R2 question 4). Issued by: ORC runtime, the fence node first in the cycle (occasion before-fence, attempt 0, with the preparation's budget) and the gate node before every gate attempt (occasion before-gate).

}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule FailCycle {
    when: FailCycle(cycle_id, stage, reason, detail)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. already concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    -- 3. the stage is not the one the cycle reached
    requires: stage = cycle.stage
    -- 4. the reason does not belong to the stage
    requires:
        (reason = fence_refused implies stage = fence)
        and (reason = candidate_not_regenerated implies stage = regenerate)
        and (reason = gate_attempts_exhausted implies stage = gate)
        and (reason = score_stage_failed implies stage = score)
    -- 5. an infrastructure failure is not at the gate
    requires: reason = infrastructure implies stage = gate
    ensures:
        cycle.status = cycle_failed
        cycle.failed_stage = stage
        cycle.failure_reason = reason
        cycle.failure_detail = detail
        CycleFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, stage: stage, reason: reason, detail: detail, candidate_digest: cycle.candidate_digest)
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/harness-self-check.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/harness-self-check.edn
rule RecordHarnessSelfCheck {
    when: RecordHarnessSelfCheck(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, occasion, attempt, harness_digest, goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest, outcome, failing_check?, detail?, skipped_checks, missing_goldens, budget, grader_digests, reworded_goldens)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. the goldens digest is not the current goldens
    requires: goldens_digest = goldens_digest_of(CurrentGoldens)
    -- 3. already recorded for this cycle, occasion and attempt (a replay records nothing)
    requires: not exists HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. failed without naming the failing check
    requires: outcome = check_failed implies failing_check != null
    -- 5. before the fence: the cycle's first fact, attempt 0
    requires: occasion = before_fence implies (not exists cycle and attempt = 0)
    -- 6. before a gate attempt: the running cycle of this cut, with the attempt's candidate
    requires: occasion = before_gate implies (exists cycle and cycle.status = running and cycle.cut_id = cut_id and cycle.attempts = attempt)
    -- 7. the preparation's budget, within AGENTS.md's limits (H5)
    requires: budget.gate_attempt_limit >= 1 and budget.gate_attempt_limit <= 3 and budget.max_continuations <= 3
    -- 8. a self-check with a missing golden cannot pass (legacy @harness-060, @harness-061)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies missing_goldens.count = 0
    -- 9. a self-check with a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written cannot
    --    pass: the fix is to re-record the golden with a logged reason (decisions.md h; R2
    --    question 5)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies reworded_goldens.count = 0
    -- 10. a reworded golden is not one of the current goldens whose scenario digest moved
    requires: reworded_goldens.all(g => exists CurrentGolden{golden_id: g})
    ensures:
        HarnessSelfCheck.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            cut_id: cut_id,
            occasion: occasion,
            attempt: attempt,
            harness_digest: harness_digest,
            goldens_digest: goldens_digest,
            grader_digests: grader_digests,
            identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest,
            outcome: outcome,
            failing_check: failing_check,
            skipped_checks: skipped_checks,
            checked_at: now
        )
        if outcome = check_passed:
            HarnessSelfCheckPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, goldens_digest: goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest, skipped_checks: skipped_checks, budget: budget, grader_digests: grader_digests)
        else:
            HarnessSelfCheckFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, failing_check: failing_check, detail: detail, budget: budget, reworded_goldens: reworded_goldens)
}
record-harness-self-checkCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the result of the harness self-check run for a cycle: the harness's calibration fixtures, every instrument golden reproduced exactly, the committed revision and runtime assets, the identity probe. A failed check is named; a tool not found is a listed skip; a missing golden, or a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written, fails it (R2 question 5). Keyed on the harness digest, the goldens digest and the approved grader digests (R2 question 4). Issued by: ORC runtime, the fence node first in the cycle (occasion before-fence, attempt 0, with the preparation's budget) and the gate node before every gate attempt (occasion before-gate).

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/gate-attempt.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/gate-attempt.edn
rule InstallCandidateInGateRoom {
    when: InstallCandidateInGateRoom(orc, cycle_id, attempt, candidate_digest, purpose, gate_room)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. no candidate regenerated for the attempt
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.attempts = attempt
    -- 2. another candidate digest
    requires: candidate_digest = cycle.candidate_digest
    -- 3. already installed
    requires: not exists GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        GateAttempt.created(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, purpose: purpose, gate_room: gate_room, verdict: awaiting, last_refusal: null)
        CandidateInstalledInGateRoom(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, gate_room: gate_room)
}

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule FailCycle {
    when: FailCycle(cycle_id, stage, reason, detail)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. already concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    -- 3. the stage is not the one the cycle reached
    requires: stage = cycle.stage
    -- 4. the reason does not belong to the stage
    requires:
        (reason = fence_refused implies stage = fence)
        and (reason = candidate_not_regenerated implies stage = regenerate)
        and (reason = gate_attempts_exhausted implies stage = gate)
        and (reason = score_stage_failed implies stage = score)
    -- 5. an infrastructure failure is not at the gate
    requires: reason = infrastructure implies stage = gate
    ensures:
        cycle.status = cycle_failed
        cycle.failed_stage = stage
        cycle.failure_reason = reason
        cycle.failure_detail = detail
        CycleFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, stage: stage, reason: reason, detail: detail, candidate_digest: cycle.candidate_digest)
}

rule RecordGateRefusal {
    when: RecordGateRefusal(orc, cycle_id, attempt, refusal, detail)
    let gate = GateAttempt{cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt}
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. not installed
    requires: exists gate
    -- 2. already has a verdict: a refusal is never recorded over a verdict
    requires: gate.verdict = awaiting
    -- 3. the cycle is concluded
    requires: exists cycle and cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        gate.last_refusal = refusal
        GateAttemptRefused(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}
