Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule RecordRegeneratedCandidate {
    when: RecordRegeneratedCandidate(orc, cycle_id, attempt, purpose, candidate_digest, parent_candidate_digest?, mounted_evidence)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. no clean room proved
    requires: cycle.clean_room_proved
    -- 3. the attempt is the next one
    requires: attempt = cycle.attempts + 1
    -- 4. within the budget's gate-attempt limit, at most three (H5, AGENTS.md)
    requires: attempt <= cycle.budget.gate_attempt_limit
    -- 5. fresh generation for attempt 1, verification repair after
    requires: (attempt = 1 implies purpose = fresh_generation) and (attempt > 1 implies purpose = verification_repair)
    -- 6. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    -- 7. a repair follows a failed gate attempt, never a passed one
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate and cycle.failed_attempts = attempt - 1
    -- 8. a repair's parent is not the previous candidate
    requires: purpose = verification_repair implies parent_candidate_digest = cycle.candidate_digest
    -- 9. only a repair room mounts evidence, and only this cycle's gate evidence (H6)
    requires: (purpose = fresh_generation implies mounted_evidence.count = 0) and mounted_evidence.all(e => e in cycle.gate_evidence_roots)
    ensures:
        cycle.attempts = attempt
        cycle.candidate_digest = candidate_digest
        cycle.stage = gate
        cycle.stage_entered_at = now
        CandidateRegenerated(cycle_id: cycle_id, attempt: attempt, purpose: purpose, candidate_digest: candidate_digest, parent_candidate_digest: parent_candidate_digest)
}

Given harness self-check passed was recorded for cycle C-7 before the fence on source cut K-3
When ORC runtime records the clean room of cycle C-7 from source cut K-3 with one root commit, one commit, fenced paths "harness/score.clj" and "harness/cycles", every fenced path matched, none left in the tree and none reachable in the object graph

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/clean-room.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/clean-room.edn
rule ProveCleanRoom {
    when: ProveCleanRoom(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, clean_room_commit, fenced_paths, root_commits, commits, unmatched_paths, paths_left_in_tree, paths_reachable_in_object_graph)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the harness self-check before the fence did not pass (no cycle, or it failed)
    requires: exists cycle and not cycle.self_check_failed
    -- 2. a fenced path matched nothing (legacy: "FENCE FAILED: <p> matches nothing")
    requires: unmatched_paths.count = 0
    -- 3. the room has more than one root commit
    requires: root_commits = 1
    -- 4. the room's history is not a single commit
    requires: commits = 1
    -- 5. a fenced path left in the working tree
    requires: paths_left_in_tree.count = 0
    -- 6. a fenced path reachable in the object graph (the prior candidate)
    requires: paths_reachable_in_object_graph.count = 0
    -- 7. already proved
    requires: not exists CleanRoom{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 8. the cut is not the self-checked cut
    requires: cut_id = cycle.cut_id
    -- 9. a scoring tool is not fenced: no grading harness in the room (H25)
    requires: ctx/config.scoring_tool_paths.all(t => t in fenced_paths)
    -- 10. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        CleanRoom.created(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, clean_room_commit: clean_room_commit, fenced_paths: fenced_paths, proved_at: now)
        CleanRoomProved(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, clean_room_commit: clean_room_commit, fenced_paths: fenced_paths)
}

rule ProveCleanRoom {
    when: ProveCleanRoom(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, clean_room_commit, fenced_paths, root_commits, commits, unmatched_paths, paths_left_in_tree, paths_reachable_in_object_graph)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the harness self-check before the fence did not pass (no cycle, or it failed)
    requires: exists cycle and not cycle.self_check_failed
    -- 2. a fenced path matched nothing (legacy: "FENCE FAILED: <p> matches nothing")
    requires: unmatched_paths.count = 0
    -- 3. the room has more than one root commit
    requires: root_commits = 1
    -- 4. the room's history is not a single commit
    requires: commits = 1
    -- 5. a fenced path left in the working tree
    requires: paths_left_in_tree.count = 0
    -- 6. a fenced path reachable in the object graph (the prior candidate)
    requires: paths_reachable_in_object_graph.count = 0
    -- 7. already proved
    requires: not exists CleanRoom{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 8. the cut is not the self-checked cut
    requires: cut_id = cycle.cut_id
    -- 9. a scoring tool is not fenced: no grading harness in the room (H25)
    requires: ctx/config.scoring_tool_paths.all(t => t in fenced_paths)
    -- 10. the cycle is concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        CleanRoom.created(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, clean_room_commit: clean_room_commit, fenced_paths: fenced_paths, proved_at: now)
        CleanRoomProved(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, clean_room_commit: clean_room_commit, fenced_paths: fenced_paths)
}

Event in :regeneration-cycle · aggregate Harness self check

harness-self-check-failed

The harness failed its self-check for this cycle; the failing check is named. Before the fence no clean room is built; before a gate attempt nothing is booted or graded and no attempt is spent; the cycle fails.

.pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/harness-self-check.edn · open the aggregate

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/harness-self-check.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/harness-self-check.edn
rule RecordHarnessSelfCheck {
    when: RecordHarnessSelfCheck(orc, cycle_id, cut_id, occasion, attempt, harness_digest, goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest, outcome, failing_check?, detail?, skipped_checks, missing_goldens, budget, grader_digests, reworded_goldens)
    let cycle = cyc.RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cut is not pinned
    requires: exists PinnedCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. the goldens digest is not the current goldens
    requires: goldens_digest = goldens_digest_of(CurrentGoldens)
    -- 3. already recorded for this cycle, occasion and attempt (a replay records nothing)
    requires: not exists HarnessSelfCheck{cycle_id: cycle_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt}
    -- 4. failed without naming the failing check
    requires: outcome = check_failed implies failing_check != null
    -- 5. before the fence: the cycle's first fact, attempt 0
    requires: occasion = before_fence implies (not exists cycle and attempt = 0)
    -- 6. before a gate attempt: the running cycle of this cut, with the attempt's candidate
    requires: occasion = before_gate implies (exists cycle and cycle.status = running and cycle.cut_id = cut_id and cycle.attempts = attempt)
    -- 7. the preparation's budget, within AGENTS.md's limits (H5)
    requires: budget.gate_attempt_limit >= 1 and budget.gate_attempt_limit <= 3 and budget.max_continuations <= 3
    -- 8. a self-check with a missing golden cannot pass (legacy @harness-060, @harness-061)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies missing_goldens.count = 0
    -- 9. a self-check with a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written cannot
    --    pass: the fix is to re-record the golden with a logged reason (decisions.md h; R2
    --    question 5)
    requires: outcome = check_passed implies reworded_goldens.count = 0
    -- 10. a reworded golden is not one of the current goldens whose scenario digest moved
    requires: reworded_goldens.all(g => exists CurrentGolden{golden_id: g})
    ensures:
        HarnessSelfCheck.created(
            cycle_id: cycle_id,
            cut_id: cut_id,
            occasion: occasion,
            attempt: attempt,
            harness_digest: harness_digest,
            goldens_digest: goldens_digest,
            grader_digests: grader_digests,
            identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest,
            outcome: outcome,
            failing_check: failing_check,
            skipped_checks: skipped_checks,
            checked_at: now
        )
        if outcome = check_passed:
            HarnessSelfCheckPassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, goldens_digest: goldens_digest, identity_probe_digest: identity_probe_digest, skipped_checks: skipped_checks, budget: budget, grader_digests: grader_digests)
        else:
            HarnessSelfCheckFailed(cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, occasion: occasion, attempt: attempt, harness_digest: harness_digest, failing_check: failing_check, detail: detail, budget: budget, reworded_goldens: reworded_goldens)
}
record-harness-self-checkCommand · :regeneration-cycle

Record the result of the harness self-check run for a cycle: the harness's calibration fixtures, every instrument golden reproduced exactly, the committed revision and runtime assets, the identity probe. A failed check is named; a tool not found is a listed skip; a missing golden, or a golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written, fails it (R2 question 5). Keyed on the harness digest, the goldens digest and the approved grader digests (R2 question 4). Issued by: ORC runtime, the fence node first in the cycle (occasion before-fence, attempt 0, with the preparation's budget) and the gate node before every gate attempt (occasion before-gate).

Policy (to-do processor) in :regeneration-cycle · aggregate Regeneration cycle

conclude-cycle

Whenever the scoreboard is reported after the measurement was filed, conclude the cycle passed; whenever a self-check failed (before the fence or before a gate attempt), the last gate attempt its budget allows failed, the gate refused three times in a row for infrastructure (R2 question 2), or its score stage failed, conclude it failed. Once per cycle.

Source: .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/allium/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/spec/regeneration-cycle/event-model/regeneration-cycle.edn
rule PassCycle {
    when: PassCycle(cycle_id)
    let cycle = RegenerationCycle{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 1. the cycle exists
    requires: exists cycle
    -- 2. the measurement is not filed or the scoreboard is not reported
    requires: cycle.measurement_filed and cycle.scoreboard_reported
    -- 3. already concluded
    requires: cycle.status = running
    ensures:
        cycle.status = cycle_passed
        cycle.stage = result
        CyclePassed(cycle_id: cycle_id, candidate_digest: cycle.candidate_digest)
}

Level 1 · event model · bounded context · slice 05-cycle-preparation

Cycle preparation

Cycle preparation (operator control): what a cycle is built from. R1 holds the source cut only; selection, approval and submission come later.

1 flows1 commands1 events1 read models1 rules4 stamped items1 drafts

How it flows

Each flow of the event model, left to right: who triggers it, the command, the event it records, and the read model or view that shows it next. Click a sticky for its spec card.

who triggers itcommandeventread model / view

Cut to fence

A pinned cut is what the checklist is derived from and what the fence builds a clean room of; the harness self-check of a cycle names its cut. The flow stays inside this context: Measurement and the Regeneration cycle fold source-cut-pinned (a handoff) into their own pinned-cuts, so this context's model validates alone, as a candidate registers it (decisions.md, "Slice 05").

Open questions

Allium open questions: what no source settles yet.

  • H35: does an unapproved preparation, or an unused cut, expire?
  • H5: the budget (gate-attempt limit, outer cycles, a timeout per stage, continuations) belongs to the approved preparation. Until it is modelled, ORC gives it to the cycle with its first self-check (regeneration-cycle); confirm that the preparation, when it arrives, carries exactly those fields.

A pinned cut is what the checklist is derived from and what the fence builds a clean room of; the harness self-check of a cycle names its cut. The flow stays inside this context: Measurement and the Regeneration cycle fold source-cut-pinned (a handoff) into their own pinned-cuts, so this context's model validates alone, as a candidate registers it (decisions.md, "Slice 05").

Context

Scope: the shared language of Cycle preparation (operator control): what a cycle is built from. The core holds only the source cut; slice proposal, selection, the approved preparation (with its budget, decisions.md H5) and submission (which mints the cycle identity, H8) arrive in a later round and add files here without renaming these. Aggregates (one file each; .pi/spec/cycle-preparation/event-model/): SourceCut source-cut.allium one per cut; immutable once pinned Handoff produced: SourceCutPinned, to measurement and the regeneration cycle (source-cut.allium).

Source cut

Aggregate SourceCut, in the harness's event store: one per cut (event-model/source-cut.edn). Immutable once pinned: everything later binds to its commit and tree content, the checklist by its cut and the cycle by its self-check. Legacy: the spec is "cut (tagged, frozen)" before a cycle (README, The idea in five lines).

Pin an immutable source cut: one commit and its tree content. Issued by the operator. Refusal 1 from R1; 2-3 added in R2 (R1's "later": the tree is the commit's).

Source: .pi/spec/cycle-preparation/allium/source-cut.allium · .pi/spec/cycle-preparation/event-model/source-cut.edn
rule PinSourceCut {
    when: PinSourceCut(operator, cut_id, commit, tree_digest)
    -- 1. the cut identity is already pinned: a cut is immutable, and pinning it again,
    --    with the same content or another, records nothing
    requires: not exists SourceCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. not a commit of the project repository
    requires: is_commit(commit)
    -- 3. the tree digest is not the commit's tree
    requires: tree_of(commit) = tree_digest
    ensures:
        SourceCut.created(cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, tree_digest: tree_digest, pinned_at: now)
        SourceCutPinned(cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, tree_digest: tree_digest)
}

Invariants and guarantees

What always holds, what a surface promises, and what a contract holds at the boundary, each with the scenarios that check it.

invariant

One cut per identity

1 example

Invariants

A pinned source cut is never pinned again
Given source cut K-3 was pinned at commit "4f2a9c1e0b7d3a5f9c2e8b1d4a6f0c3e7b9d2a51" with the tree digest "t-81"
And commit "9b07e2d4c8a1f6035e9d2b7c4a0f8e1d6b3c5a92" of the project repository has the tree digest "t-82"
When the operator pins source cut K-3 at commit "9b07e2d4c8a1f6035e9d2b7c4a0f8e1d6b3c5a92" with the tree digest "t-82"
Then the pinning is refused
And the pinned source cuts hold one source cut K-3, at commit "4f2a9c1e0b7d3a5f9c2e8b1d4a6f0c3e7b9d2a51" with the tree digest "t-81"
covers 2 obligations
  • guarantee Immutable once pinned
  • invariant One cut per identity

Under the hoodAllium invariant OneCutPerIdentity · @allium-invariant.OneCutPerIdentity
invariant OneCutPerIdentity {
    for a in SourceCuts:
        for b in SourceCuts:
            a != b implies a.cut_id != b.cut_id
}
guarantee

When the operator pins source cut K-3 at commit "4f2a9c1e0b7d3a5f9c2e8b1d4a6f0c3e7b9d2a51" with the tree digest "t-81"
Then source cut K-3 is pinned at commit "4f2a9c1e0b7d3a5f9c2e8b1d4a6f0c3e7b9d2a51" with the tree digest "t-81"
And the pinned source cuts show source cut K-3 with that commit and tree digest
.pi/spec/cycle-preparation/spec.feature:11 · Rule: A source cut is one commit and its tree, pinned once and never changed
Source: .pi/spec/cycle-preparation/allium/source-cut.allium · .pi/spec/cycle-preparation/event-model/source-cut.edn
rule PinSourceCut {
    when: PinSourceCut(operator, cut_id, commit, tree_digest)
    -- 1. the cut identity is already pinned: a cut is immutable, and pinning it again,
    --    with the same content or another, records nothing
    requires: not exists SourceCut{cut_id: cut_id}
    -- 2. not a commit of the project repository
    requires: is_commit(commit)
    -- 3. the tree digest is not the commit's tree
    requires: tree_of(commit) = tree_digest
    ensures:
        SourceCut.created(cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, tree_digest: tree_digest, pinned_at: now)
        SourceCutPinned(cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, tree_digest: tree_digest)
}

Level 1 · event model · bounded context · slice 06-cycle-runner

Cycle runner

Cycle runner: the ORC workflow that performs one cycle's effects (stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install and gate with repair, file the verdicts and the score) and records each effect's result into the context that owns it, relaying every handoff from its producer's store. It owns no rule of the five contexts.

4 flows6 commands6 events4 read models9 rules52 stamped items0 drafts

How it flows

Each flow of the event model, left to right: who triggers it, the command, the event it records, and the read model or view that shows it next. Click a sticky for its spec card.

who triggers itcommandeventread model / view

Run to gate

The operator starts a run; the advance-run processor performs the effects up to the gate's verdict (stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check, gate; a repair after each failed attempt the budget allows), records each into its context, relays the handoffs, and stops when the run awaits its verdicts.

Spec cards

Context0 rules · 28 scenariosOpen →

Scope: the shared language of the Cycle runner (slice 06; drafted in spec round 7a, accepted in spec round 7b, decisions.md "Spec round 7b"): the OR…

Cycle run9 rules · 28 scenariosOpen →

Aggregate CycleRun, in the runner's own event store: one per run (event-model/cycle-run.edn).

  • Start run A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
  • Record effect A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
  • Record effect after the verdicts The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
  • Relay handoff The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
  • Hand in verdicts The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
  • Conclude with the cycle No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
  • Conclude run passed The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
  • Conclude run failed No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
  • Halt run The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store

Policies, timers, read models and queries

effect-recordedhandoff-relayedrun-startedverdicts-handed-inruns-to-advanceto-do→advance-runpolicy→conclude-runhalt-runrecord-effectrelay-handoff

Whenever a run started, an effect was recorded, a handoff relayed or the verdicts handed in: relay the producer's new handoffs; then, if the cycle concluded, conclude the run; else perform the run's next effect in the real world and record its result into its context; if the effect could not be performed at all, halt the run. Stops when the run awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted.

effect-recorded→effect-resultsread model→run-progressquery

Each run's effect results, in the order performed: effect, attempt, context, method, outcome, refusal, events, detail.

handoff-relayed→relayed-handoffsread model→run-progressquery

Each run's relayed handoffs, in the order relayed: type, producer, position in the producer's store, consumer, outcome.

effect-recordedrun-concludedrun-haltedrun-startedverdicts-handed-in→runsread model→run-progressquery

Each run: its cycle, cut and commit, its status (running, awaiting-verdicts, grading, passed, failed, halted), the effects recorded, the candidates regenerated, the verdicts digest, and how it ended.

effect-recordedhandoff-relayedrun-concludedrun-haltedrun-startedverdicts-handed-in→runs-to-advanceread model→runs-to-advancequery

The advance-run processor's to-do list: runs running or grading whose next effect, relay or conclusion is due; a run that awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted leaves it.

The operator starts a run; the advance-run processor performs the effects up to the gate's verdict (stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check, gate; a repair after each failed attempt the budget allows), records each into its context, relays the handoffs, and stops when the run awaits its verdicts.

The operator hands in the verdicts file of the gated candidate; the advance-run processor files the verdicts and the score with Measurement, relays its handoffs to the Regeneration cycle, and concludes the run as the cycle concluded.

The boundary: what holds everywhere

The actors that may act (Operator, CycleRunner), any contract every surface fulfils, and what others own.

outside the harnessOperatorAccount
OnlyThroughTheSeams · The runner records into a context only by calling a method of its seam, and reads a context only through its queries and, for the relay, the handoff events of its own store. It never reads a context's source and never writes into a context's store.1 scenariocontract ContextSeams · @allium-boundary.OnlyThroughTheSeams

RefusalsAreTheContexts · Every refusal of a recording is the context's reply, recorded as heard: the refusal code of its seam, never re-derived. MeasurementKeepsItsHistory · Each context is started for a run on a fresh store, except Measurement when a measurement history store is handed in: Measurement is then started on that one file for every run, and it is kept when the run ends, so its scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of the same selection across runs (AGENTS.md, the scoreboard; measurement contract Comparison, LastMeasuredCycleOfTheSameSelection). TheBuilderRunsInTheConfiguredImage · When the configuration names a builder image, every builder of the run, fresh and repair, is launched with that image: the folder of its name in the builder images directory handed in, as the builder command's third argument. Each regenerate and repair effect names the image and its digest in its detail. A configuration that names none launches the builder with two arguments, as before (decisions.md, "Spec round 9" D1). The builder image named for a stack carries that stack's toolchain, the same tools the gate's host runs the candidate with (for Clojure: a JDK, the Clojure CLI, git and bb), so a builder never brings its own. Proving that is the provided image build's (harness/Makefile), when it builds the image, never the runner's: the runner checks only that the named image is there, and records which one each builder ran in (decisions.md, "Spec round 9" D2, D4).1 scenariocontract BuilderLaunch · @allium-boundary.TheBuilderRunsInTheConfiguredImage

TheLegacyGateOrder · For the http seam (config app_seam absent or http), as before spec round 8: the first guard that does not hold is the gate's reply, in legacy verify.sh's order; the port already answering is a refusal to grade, not a failed attempt (decisions.md b). After a refusal to grade is recorded, the runner gates the same attempt again on the attempt's self-check, which stands: it does not self-check again, as the Regeneration cycle records one self-check per attempt (decisions.md, "Spec round 8b"). TheStdioGateOrder · For the stdio seam, the first guard that does not hold is the gate's reply, in harness/v2/gate.sh's order (harness/verify.sh, then the event-store check), each step in the writable gate room with gate.sh's arguments (seam.md, E5): test.sh and start.sh executable, else contract_missing; the identity probe present and executable at the cut, else the refusal identity_probe_missing; no port, so the seam never answered before boot; test.sh with no argument, else suite_red; the probe with two, the gate room's start.sh and the boot budget in seconds, else identity_probe_failed; the store check, else identity_probe_failed with its output as the detail. A pass is one poll of a stdio_boot_budget_seconds budget, answered on that poll. A store check that cannot be started is an effect that could not run: the run halts, and the gate records nothing.4 scenarioscontract GateOnTheHost · @allium-boundary.TheStdioGateOrder

Level 2 · spec cards · context.allium in Cycle runner

Context

Scope: the shared language of the Cycle runner (slice 06; drafted in spec round 7a, accepted in spec round 7b, decisions.md "Spec round 7b"): the ORC workflow that performs a cycle's effects in the real world and records each effect's result into the context that owns it, through that context's seam. It owns no rule of the five contexts: every refusal it shows is a context's, as heard, and a run ends as its cycle ends. One run in the legacy shape (archive/legacy-harness/README.md), the effects E1 to E8 of the stage-1 triage (decisions.md, "Slice 06 (draft)"): stamp, pin, checklist -> self-check -> fence -> regenerate -> install, self-check, gate (repair, at most three attempts) -> the verdicts handed in -> file the verdicts, file the score -> the cycle concludes After every recording the runner relays the producer's new handoffs, from the producer's own store, to every consumer, in the producer's order (decisions.md, "Spec round 5"). Aggregates (one file; .pi/spec/cycle-runner/event-model/): CycleRun cycle-run.allium one per run; its effect results and relayed handoffs Handoffs: none consumed and none produced. The five contexts' events never enter the runner's store: it reads them from each producer's store and hands them in through the consumers' seams.

Rules

One card per rule: what it says in plain words, then the scenarios that show it. Drafts, not yet accepted, have a dashed amber edge. The Allium, the Grain block and the coverage of each card are under its hood.

No rules.

Invariants and guarantees

What always holds, what a surface promises, and what a contract holds at the boundary, each with the scenarios that check it.

boundary

Only through the seams

1 example

The runner records into a context only by calling a method of its seam, and reads a context only through its queries and, for the relay, the handoff events of its own store. It never reads a context's source and never writes into a context's store.

Held at the boundary by contract ContextSeams

And run R-1 is halted at the checklist effect for a refusal before the cycle
And it has no self-check effect and no fence effect

Measurement keeps its history

1 example

Each context is started for a run on a fresh store, except Measurement when a measurement history store is handed in: Measurement is then started on that one file for every run, and it is kept when the run ends, so its scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of the same selection across runs. The relay hands on only the handoffs that store gained during this run. With none handed in, Measurement too starts fresh and every scoreboard is a baseline.

Held at the boundary by contract ContextSeams

Two runs handed one measurement history store compare the second cycle with the first
Given the operator hands in the measurement history store H
And run R-1 of cycle C-1 at source cut K-1 was handed its verdicts and passed with its cycle
When the operator starts run R-2 of cycle C-2 at source cut K-2, everything else the same, and hands in its verdicts
Then Measurement's scoreboard of cycle C-2, read from H through Measurement's own seam after run R-2 ended, has the previous cycle C-1
And run R-2's relayed handoffs from measurement are one measurement/measurement-filed and one measurement/scoreboard-reported, each to regeneration-cycle
covers 1 obligation

boundary

The builder runs in the configured image

1 example

When the configuration names a builder image, every builder of the run, fresh and repair, is launched with that image: the folder of its name in the builder images directory handed in, as the builder command's third argument. Each regenerate and repair effect names the image and its digest in its detail. A configuration that names none launches the builder with two arguments, as before. The builder image named for a stack carries that stack's toolchain, the same tools the gate's host runs the candidate with (for Clojure: a JDK, the Clojure CLI, git and bb), so a builder never brings its own. Proving that is the provided image build's (harness/Makefile), when it builds the image, never the runner's: the runner checks only that the named image is there, and records which one each builder ran in.

The gate grades acopy

2 examples

The gate grades a copy of the candidate taken when its builder session ended, in a gate room the builder never had: what the builder does after it ends does not reach what the gate grades. The gate room is the gate's, out of the builder's reach, and writable by the candidate's own test.sh and start.sh, as legacy verify.sh runs the candidate in a writable tree. The candidate digest recorded at install is the copy's as taken, before the gate runs: what the candidate's own run writes does not change it.

boundary

The legacy gate order

5 examples

For the http seam (config app_seam absent or http), as before spec round 8: the first guard that does not hold is the gate's reply, in legacy verify.sh's order; the port already answering is a refusal to grade, not a failed attempt. Each step runs in the writable gate room and takes legacy verify.sh's arguments: test.sh none; start.sh the port; the identity probe the served URL, "http://127.0.0.1:" followed by the port, never the bare port. After a refusal to grade is recorded, the runner gates the same attempt again on the attempt's self-check, which stands: it does not self-check again, as the Regeneration cycle records one self-check per attempt. The same holds for the stdio seam.

Under the hoodAllium boundary TheLegacyGateOrder · @allium-boundary.TheLegacyGateOrder

For the http seam (config app_seam absent or http), as before spec round 8: the first guard that does not hold is the gate's reply, in legacy verify.sh's order; the port already answering is a refusal to grade, not a failed attempt (decisions.md b). Each step runs in the writable gate room and takes legacy verify.sh's arguments (seam.md, E5): test.sh none; start.sh the port; the identity probe the served URL, "http://127.0.0.1:" followed by the port, never the bare port (decisions.md, "Spec round 7c"). After a refusal to grade is recorded, the runner gates the same attempt again on the attempt's self-check, which stands: it does not self-check again, as the Regeneration cycle records one self-check per attempt (decisions.md, "Spec round 8b"). The same holds for the stdio seam.

boundary

The stdio gate order

4 examples

For the stdio seam, the first guard that does not hold is the gate's reply, in harness/v2/gate.sh's order, each step in the writable gate room with gate.sh's arguments: test.sh and start.sh executable, else contract_missing; the identity probe present and executable at the cut, else the refusal identity_probe_missing; no port, so the seam never answered before boot; test.sh with no argument, else suite_red; the probe with two, the gate room's start.sh and the boot budget in seconds, else identity_probe_failed; the store check, else identity_probe_failed with its output as the detail. A pass is one poll of a stdio_boot_budget_seconds budget, answered on that poll. A store check that cannot be started is an effect that could not run: the run halts, and the gate records nothing.

The store check reads the probes store

2 examples

The suite is handed no store: no variable of the runner's own whose name starts LOYLY_ reaches test.sh, the probe or the store check, and neither does a GATE_STORE the runner itself inherited. The probe alone is handed the attempt's gate store, a fresh file outside the gate room, as GATE_STORE, and hands it to the candidate it launches; the store check is handed that same path, so it reads only what the probe caused, as harness/v2/gate.sh's does.

The gate room holds the clean room

2 examples

For either seam the gate room is a copy of the gated tree: the clean room's files plus the candidate's copy at its scope, so the candidate reads the spec beside it as in its builder room. For the http seam the gate room is legacy verify.sh's ROOT (line 23): the probe is checked -x "$ROOT/$APP_PROBE" (line 36) and run as "$ROOT/$APP_PROBE" "$URL" (line 154), with no change of directory and nothing else added. The candidate digest is still its scope's alone.

Level 2 · spec cards · cycle-run.allium in Cycle runner

Cycle run

Aggregate CycleRun, in the runner's own event store: one per run (event-model/cycle-run.edn). A run performs one cycle's effects in the real world (a git repository read, a clean room built, a builder launched and waited for, a gate run on the host) and records each effect's result into the context that owns it, through that context's seam. Its own facts are only that: which effect was performed and what the context answered, which handoff it relayed and how the consumer took it, the verdicts handed in, and how the run ended. Drafted in decisions.md "Slice 06 (draft)", accepted in "Spec round 7b". Legacy: the operator's hands between the legacy tools (archive/legacy-harness/README.md, "A cycle"): fence.sh, a builder session, verify.sh, a grading subagent's verdicts file, score.clj, scoreboard.clj; and harness/v2/assemble.clj, the relay.

One card per rule: what it says in plain words, then the scenarios that show it. Drafts, not yet accepted, have a dashed amber edge. The Allium, the Grain block and the coverage of each card are under its hood.

Source: .pi/spec/cycle-runner/allium/cycle-run.allium · .pi/spec/cycle-runner/event-model/cycle-run.edn
rule StartRun {
    when: StartRun(operator, run_id, cycle_id, cut_id, commit, selection_id, budget, grader_digests)
    -- 1. the run identity is taken: a second start records nothing
    requires: not exists CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 2. another run is in progress: one run at a time (one port, one builder)
    requires: not exists CycleRun{status: running} and not exists CycleRun{status: awaiting_verdicts} and not exists CycleRun{status: grading}
    -- 3. the cycle was run before: a cycle is numbered once (decisions.md H8)
    requires: not exists CycleRun{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 4. not a commit of the project repository
    requires: is_commit(commit)
    -- 5. a context's candidate is not handed in, or does not respond on its seam
    requires: contexts_respond(run_id)
    -- 6. the configuration names a builder image the builder images directory does not
    --    hold (decisions.md, "Spec round 9" D2)
    requires: builder_image_present(run_id)
    ensures:
        CycleRun.created(run_id: run_id, cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, selection_id: selection_id, budget: budget, grader_digests: grader_digests, status: running, effects: 0, attempts: 0, candidate_digest: null, verdicts_digest: null, gate_passed: false, cycle_status: null)
        RunStarted(run_id: run_id, cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, selection_id: selection_id)
}

rule

Record effect

3 examples · 3 happy paths

A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding

No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check

Record one effect's result before the verdicts: the context method it was recorded through and what the context answered. Issued by the runner's effect node, after it performed the effect. A gate attempt recorded passed leaves the run awaiting its verdicts: nothing of the score is the runner's to produce.

Given
  • Run started (Cycle run status is running)
  • Issued by Cycle runner
When
Record effect
Refused if
  • The run is not running: one that awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted performs no effect before the verdicts ◇ unit test
Then
  • createsEffect result
  • updatesCycle run effects
  • updatesCycle run attempts → attempt (in some cases)
  • updatesCycle run gate passed → true (in some cases)
  • updatesCycle run status → awaiting verdicts (in some cases)
  • emitsEffect recorded

Source: .pi/spec/cycle-runner/allium/cycle-run.allium · .pi/spec/cycle-runner/event-model/cycle-run.edn
rule RecordEffect {
    when: RecordEffect(runner, run_id, effect, attempt, context, method, outcome, refusal?, detail)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is not running: one that awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted
    --    performs no effect before the verdicts
    requires: run.status = running
    ensures:
        EffectResult.created(run: run, position: run.effects + 1, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail, after_verdicts: false, performed_at: now)
        run.effects = run.effects + 1
        if outcome = recorded and (effect = regenerate or effect = repair):
            run.attempts = attempt
        if outcome = recorded and effect = gate and gate_attempt_passed(run.cycle_id, attempt):
            run.gate_passed = true
            run.status = awaiting_verdicts
        EffectRecorded(run_id: run_id, position: run.effects, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

Relay handoff

2 examples · 1 happy path

The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store

A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended

Hand one producer's handoff in to one consumer, unchanged, and record how the consumer took it. Issued by the runner's relay node after every recording.

Given
  • Issued by Cycle runner
When
Relay handoff
Refused if
  • The run is concluded or halted ✓ 06-034
Then
  • createsRelayed handoff
  • emitsHandoff relayed
Examples
Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's orderhappy path
Given the stub builder leaves a candidate the gate passes
When the operator starts run R-1 of cycle C-1 at source cut K-1
Then the relayed handoffs of run R-1 begin with specification/scenario-stamped at positions 1 and 2 to measurement, then cycle-preparation/source-cut-pinned at position 1 to measurement and to regeneration-cycle
And regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed at position 1 is relayed to measurement once
And every relayed handoff was accepted
covers 3 obligations

  • guarantee In the producers order
  • invariant Each handoff once per consumer

Then run R-1 is still failed and run R-2 is still halted
And each shows the same effect results and relayed handoffs as when its start responded

  • refusal 1 Conclude with the cycle

Hand in verdicts

6 examples · 1 happy path

The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends

Hand in the verdicts file of the gated candidate: one verdict per checklist item, written by the grading subagent, and by the main session for an item it judges. The runner judges no item.

Given
  • Effect recorded (Cycle run status is awaiting verdicts)
  • Issued by Operator
When
Hand in verdicts
Refused if
  • No such run ✓ 06-027
  • The gate has not passed: verdicts are never taken for a candidate the gate did not ratify ✓ 06-028
  • Verdicts were already handed in: a run takes one verdicts file, and a failed score is measured, not retaken ✓ 06-029
  • The run no longer awaits its verdicts: its cycle concluded or it halted ◇ unit test
  • The grader digest is not one of the run's approved grader digests ✓ 06-030
  • The file is absent or is not a list of verdicts ✓ 06-031
  • ✓ checked by an example · ◇ checked only by the code's own tests
Then
  • updatesCycle run verdicts digest
  • updatesCycle run status → grading
  • emitsVerdicts handed in

rule HandInVerdicts {
    when: HandInVerdicts(operator, run_id, verdicts_path, grader_digest)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. no such run
    requires: exists run
    -- 2. the gate has not passed: verdicts are never taken for a candidate the gate did
    --    not ratify
    requires: run.gate_passed
    -- 3. verdicts were already handed in: a run takes one verdicts file, and a failed
    --    score is measured, not retaken
    requires: run.verdicts_digest = null
    -- 4. the run no longer awaits its verdicts: its cycle concluded or it halted
    requires: run.status = awaiting_verdicts
    -- 5. the grader digest is not one of the run's approved grader digests
    requires: grader_digest in run.grader_digests
    -- 6. the file is absent or is not a list of verdicts
    requires: verdicts_readable(verdicts_path)
    ensures:
        run.verdicts_digest = digest_of_file(verdicts_path)
        run.status = grading
        VerdictsHandedIn(run_id: run_id, verdicts_path: verdicts_path, verdicts_digest: digest_of_file(verdicts_path), grader_digest: grader_digest)
}

advance-runPolicy (to-do processor) · :cycle-runner

Whenever a run started, an effect was recorded, a handoff relayed or the verdicts handed in: relay the producer's new handoffs; then, if the cycle concluded, conclude the run; else perform the run's next effect in the real world and record its result into its context; if the effect could not be performed at all, halt the run. Stops when the run awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted.

  :description "Whenever a run started, an effect was recorded, a handoff relayed or the verdicts handed in: relay the producer's new handoffs; then, if the cycle concluded, conclude the run; else perform the run's next effect in the real world and record its result into its context; if the effect could not be performed at all, halt the run. Stops when the run awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted."

The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends

rule

Halt run

5 examples · 4 happy paths

The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store

A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended

A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote

An effect could not be performed at all (a context did not respond, a handed-in command could not be started), so nothing is recorded for it; or the stamp, the pin or the checklist was refused before the cycle opened, or the stamp handed out identities that are not the plan's own, so there is no cycle to fail. The run halts, loudly. A halt is the runner's fact, never the cycle's conclusion.

  • Issued by Cycle runner
When
Halt run
Refused if
  • The run is concluded or halted ✓ 06-034
Then

  • updatesCycle run halt reason → reason

Source: .pi/spec/cycle-runner/allium/cycle-run.allium · .pi/spec/cycle-runner/event-model/cycle-run.edn
rule HaltRun {
    when: HaltRun(runner, run_id, effect, reason, detail)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is concluded or halted
    requires: run.status in {running, awaiting_verdicts, grading}
    ensures:
        run.status = halted
        run.halt_reason = reason
        RunHalted(run_id: run_id, effect: effect, reason: reason, detail: detail)
}

One result per position

1 example

An effect result is recorded once, at its own position: a replayed effect records nothing.

The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
Given the stub builder leaves a candidate whose suite is green and whose launch entrypoint serves the marker on the port
When the operator starts run R-1 of cycle C-1 at source cut K-1, commit "4f2a9c1e0b7d3a5f9c2e8b1d4a6f0c3e7b9d2a51"
Then run R-1 awaits its verdicts
And its effect results, at positions 1 to 9, are stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check and gate, each recorded
And the gate effect's events are "regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed"
covers 3 obligations

When the operator hands in another verdicts file for run R-1 with the grader digest "r-1"

Allium source.pi/spec/cycle-runner/allium/cycle-run.allium
entity CycleRun {
    run_id: String
    cycle_id: String
    cut_id: String
    commit: String
    selection_id: String
    budget: ctx.RunBudget
    grader_digests: Set<String>
    status: running | awaiting_verdicts | grading | run_passed | run_failed | halted
    -- Effects recorded so far; the next is recorded at position effects + 1.
    effects: Integer
    -- Candidates regenerated so far.
    attempts: Integer
    candidate_digest: String?
    -- The digest of the verdicts file, once handed in.
    verdicts_digest: String?
    gate_passed: Boolean
    -- The cycle's conclusion as the Regeneration cycle shows it.
    cycle_status: String?
    halt_reason: ctx.HaltReason when status = halted

    in_progress: status = running or status = awaiting_verdicts or status = grading

    -- The cycle concluded in the Regeneration cycle, and the run has not yet.
    awaits_conclusion: in_progress and cycle_status_of(cycle_id) != "running"

    transitions status {
        running -> awaiting_verdicts
        running -> run_failed
        running -> halted
        awaiting_verdicts -> grading
        awaiting_verdicts -> run_failed
        awaiting_verdicts -> halted
        grading -> run_passed
        grading -> run_failed
        grading -> halted
        terminal: run_passed, run_failed, halted
    }
}
entity EffectResult {
    run: CycleRun
    position: Integer
    effect: ctx.Effect
    attempt: Integer
    context: String
    method: String
    outcome: ctx.EffectOutcome
    refusal: String?
    detail: String
    -- Whether the run's verdicts had been handed in when the effect was performed.
    after_verdicts: Boolean
    performed_at: Timestamp
}
entity RelayedHandoff {
    run: CycleRun
    handoff_type: String
    producer: String
    -- The handoff's place among its producer's handoffs of this run, in store order,
    -- from 1: a handed-in history store's earlier handoffs are not this run's.
    position: Integer
    consumer: String
    outcome: ctx.RelayOutcome
    relayed_at: Timestamp
}

Policy (to-do processor) in :cycle-runner · aggregate Cycle run

advance-run

Whenever a run started, an effect was recorded, a handoff relayed or the verdicts handed in: relay the producer's new handoffs; then, if the cycle concluded, conclude the run; else perform the run's next effect in the real world and record its result into its context; if the effect could not be performed at all, halt the run. Stops when the run awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted.

rule HandInVerdicts {
    when: HandInVerdicts(operator, run_id, verdicts_path, grader_digest)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. no such run
    requires: exists run
    -- 2. the gate has not passed: verdicts are never taken for a candidate the gate did
    --    not ratify
    requires: run.gate_passed
    -- 3. verdicts were already handed in: a run takes one verdicts file, and a failed
    --    score is measured, not retaken
    requires: run.verdicts_digest = null
    -- 4. the run no longer awaits its verdicts: its cycle concluded or it halted
    requires: run.status = awaiting_verdicts
    -- 5. the grader digest is not one of the run's approved grader digests
    requires: grader_digest in run.grader_digests
    -- 6. the file is absent or is not a list of verdicts
    requires: verdicts_readable(verdicts_path)
    ensures:
        run.verdicts_digest = digest_of_file(verdicts_path)
        run.status = grading
        VerdictsHandedIn(run_id: run_id, verdicts_path: verdicts_path, verdicts_digest: digest_of_file(verdicts_path), grader_digest: grader_digest)
}

rule ConcludeRunPassed {
    when: ConcludeRun(run_id, cycle_status)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is not grading
    requires: run.status = grading
    -- 2. the cycle did not pass
    requires: cycle_status = "passed"
    ensures:
        run.cycle_status = cycle_status
        run.status = run_passed
        RunConcluded(run_id: run_id, cycle_id: run.cycle_id, cycle_status: cycle_status)
}

}

rule HandInVerdicts {
    when: HandInVerdicts(operator, run_id, verdicts_path, grader_digest)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. no such run
    requires: exists run
    -- 2. the gate has not passed: verdicts are never taken for a candidate the gate did
    --    not ratify
    requires: run.gate_passed
    -- 3. verdicts were already handed in: a run takes one verdicts file, and a failed
    --    score is measured, not retaken
    requires: run.verdicts_digest = null
    -- 4. the run no longer awaits its verdicts: its cycle concluded or it halted
    requires: run.status = awaiting_verdicts
    -- 5. the grader digest is not one of the run's approved grader digests
    requires: grader_digest in run.grader_digests
    -- 6. the file is absent or is not a list of verdicts
    requires: verdicts_readable(verdicts_path)
    ensures:
        run.verdicts_digest = digest_of_file(verdicts_path)
        run.status = grading
        VerdictsHandedIn(run_id: run_id, verdicts_path: verdicts_path, verdicts_digest: digest_of_file(verdicts_path), grader_digest: grader_digest)
}

rule RecordEffect {
    when: RecordEffect(runner, run_id, effect, attempt, context, method, outcome, refusal?, detail)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is not running: one that awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted
    --    performs no effect before the verdicts
    requires: run.status = running
    ensures:
        EffectResult.created(run: run, position: run.effects + 1, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail, after_verdicts: false, performed_at: now)
        run.effects = run.effects + 1
        if outcome = recorded and (effect = regenerate or effect = repair):
            run.attempts = attempt
        if outcome = recorded and effect = gate and gate_attempt_passed(run.cycle_id, attempt):
            run.gate_passed = true
            run.status = awaiting_verdicts
        EffectRecorded(run_id: run_id, position: run.effects, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

rule RecordEffectAfterTheVerdicts {
    when: RecordEffect(runner, run_id, effect, attempt, context, method, outcome, refusal?, detail)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is not grading
    requires: run.status = grading
    ensures:
        EffectResult.created(run: run, position: run.effects + 1, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail, after_verdicts: true, performed_at: now)
        run.effects = run.effects + 1
        EffectRecorded(run_id: run_id, position: run.effects, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

rule StartRun {
    when: StartRun(operator, run_id, cycle_id, cut_id, commit, selection_id, budget, grader_digests)
    -- 1. the run identity is taken: a second start records nothing
    requires: not exists CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 2. another run is in progress: one run at a time (one port, one builder)
    requires: not exists CycleRun{status: running} and not exists CycleRun{status: awaiting_verdicts} and not exists CycleRun{status: grading}
    -- 3. the cycle was run before: a cycle is numbered once (decisions.md H8)
    requires: not exists CycleRun{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 4. not a commit of the project repository
    requires: is_commit(commit)
    -- 5. a context's candidate is not handed in, or does not respond on its seam
    requires: contexts_respond(run_id)
    -- 6. the configuration names a builder image the builder images directory does not
    --    hold (decisions.md, "Spec round 9" D2)
    requires: builder_image_present(run_id)

rule StartRun {
    when: StartRun(operator, run_id, cycle_id, cut_id, commit, selection_id, budget, grader_digests)
    -- 1. the run identity is taken: a second start records nothing
    requires: not exists CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 2. another run is in progress: one run at a time (one port, one builder)
    requires: not exists CycleRun{status: running} and not exists CycleRun{status: awaiting_verdicts} and not exists CycleRun{status: grading}
    -- 3. the cycle was run before: a cycle is numbered once (decisions.md H8)
    requires: not exists CycleRun{cycle_id: cycle_id}
    -- 4. not a commit of the project repository
    requires: is_commit(commit)
    -- 5. a context's candidate is not handed in, or does not respond on its seam
    requires: contexts_respond(run_id)
    -- 6. the configuration names a builder image the builder images directory does not
    --    hold (decisions.md, "Spec round 9" D2)
    requires: builder_image_present(run_id)
    ensures:
        CycleRun.created(run_id: run_id, cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, selection_id: selection_id, budget: budget, grader_digests: grader_digests, status: running, effects: 0, attempts: 0, candidate_digest: null, verdicts_digest: null, gate_passed: false, cycle_status: null)
        RunStarted(run_id: run_id, cycle_id: cycle_id, cut_id: cut_id, commit: commit, selection_id: selection_id)
}

rule RecordEffect {
    when: RecordEffect(runner, run_id, effect, attempt, context, method, outcome, refusal?, detail)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is not running: one that awaits its verdicts, concluded or halted
    --    performs no effect before the verdicts
    requires: run.status = running
    ensures:
        EffectResult.created(run: run, position: run.effects + 1, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail, after_verdicts: false, performed_at: now)
        run.effects = run.effects + 1
        if outcome = recorded and (effect = regenerate or effect = repair):
            run.attempts = attempt
        if outcome = recorded and effect = gate and gate_attempt_passed(run.cycle_id, attempt):
            run.gate_passed = true
            run.status = awaiting_verdicts
        EffectRecorded(run_id: run_id, position: run.effects, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

rule RecordEffectAfterTheVerdicts {
    when: RecordEffect(runner, run_id, effect, attempt, context, method, outcome, refusal?, detail)

        run.effects = run.effects + 1
        EffectRecorded(run_id: run_id, position: run.effects, effect: effect, attempt: attempt, context: context, method: method, outcome: outcome, refusal: refusal, detail: detail)
}

rule HaltRun {
    when: HaltRun(runner, run_id, effect, reason, detail)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is concluded or halted
    requires: run.status in {running, awaiting_verdicts, grading}
    ensures:
        run.status = halted
        run.halt_reason = reason
        RunHalted(run_id: run_id, effect: effect, reason: reason, detail: detail)
}
halt-runCommand · :cycle-runner

Halt the run: an effect could not be performed at all (a context did not respond, a handed-in command could not be started), so nothing was recorded for it; or the stamp, the pin or the checklist was refused before the cycle opened, or the stamp handed out identities that are not the plan's own, so there is no cycle to fail. A halt is the runner's fact, never the cycle's conclusion. Issued by: the advance-run processor.

rule ConcludeRunPassed {
    when: ConcludeRun(run_id, cycle_status)
    let run = CycleRun{run_id: run_id}
    -- 1. the run is not grading
    requires: run.status = grading
    -- 2. the cycle did not pass
    requires: cycle_status = "passed"
    ensures:
        run.cycle_status = cycle_status
        run.status = run_passed
        RunConcluded(run_id: run_id, cycle_id: run.cycle_id, cycle_status: cycle_status)
}
